jobs.title: (Senior) SQL Server DBA & Database Developer
jobs.description:
Te veel vacatures in IT? Stop met zoeken en word DBA bij Monta!

### **Over Monta**


Monta is hét e\-commerce bedrijf dat de logistiek voor ruim 3\.000 webwinkels verzorgt. We werken vanuit meerdere zelfstandige e\-commerce warehouses en zorgen wereldwijd voor de verwerking en bezorging van orders van haar klanten.

### **Over de rol**


Als SQL Server DBA \& Database Developer ben jij verantwoordelijk voor een omvangrijk SQL Server\-landschap met bedrijfskritische databases. Je werkt samen met softwareontwikkelaars, architecten en infrastructuurspecialisten aan een platform dat continu groeit. Je combineert operationeel beheer met databaseontwikkeling en denkt actief mee over performance, schaalbaarheid, beveiliging en toekomstige ontwikkelingen.


Daarnaast speel je een belangrijke rol bij de verdere professionalisering van ons databaseplatform en draag je actief bij aan Cloud ontwikkelingen binnen Azure.

### **Het team**


Je komt terecht binnen het IT\-team van Monta, waar development, operations en innovatie nauw samenwerken. Je werkt dagelijks samen met softwareontwikkelaars, architecten en infrastructuurspecialisten aan een platform dat continu in ontwikkeling is.


Als database specialist ben jij dé inhoudelijke sparringpartner voor alles wat betrekking heeft op SQL Server, databasearchitectuur en performance.

### **Wat ga je doen?**

* Beheer, configuratie en optimalisatie van SQL Server\-omgevingen
* Ontwerpen en verbeteren van databasestructuren en datamodellen
* Ontwikkelen en onderhouden van complexe T\-SQL oplossingen, stored procedures en views
* Query tuning en performance optimalisatie van bedrijfskritische applicaties
* Ontwerpen en beheren van indexstrategieën en partitioning\-oplossingen
* Opzetten en beheren van monitoring\- en beheeroplossingen
* Implementeren van security\-, encryptie\- en compliance\-maatregelen
* Beheer van Always On Availability Groups en high\-availability oplossingen
* Automatiseren van beheerprocessen middels PowerShell
* Uitvoeren en optimaliseren van back\-up\-, recovery\- en onderhoudsprocessen
* Ondersteunen van ontwikkelteams met databasevraagstukken en performance analyses
* Adviseren over architectuur, schaalbaarheid en toekomstige databaseontwikkelingen
* Actief bijdragen aan cloudontwikkelingen binnen Azure

  

Daarnaast deel je actief je kennis met collega's en help je ontwikkelteams om databases optimaal te gebruiken.

### **Wie zoeken wij?**


Je bent iemand die energie krijgt van complexe databaseomgevingen en technische uitdagingen. Je werkt graag aan bedrijfskritische systemen, denkt proactief mee over verbeteringen en voelt eigenaarschap voor jouw omgeving. Je bent zorgvuldig, kwaliteitsgericht en weet technische vraagstukken helder te bespreken met zowel ontwikkelaars als andere stakeholders. Daarnaast deel je graag jouw kennis met collega's en blijf je jezelf ontwikkelen binnen je vakgebied.

  

Daarnaast beschik je over:

* HBO werk\- en denkniveau
* Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring als SQL Server DBA, Database Developer of vergelijkbare functie
* Ervaring met grote en bedrijfskritische SQL Server\-omgevingen

  

Je hebt diepgaande kennis van **meerdere** van onderstaande onderwerpen:

* SQL Server configuratie en beheer
* Data modellering en normalisatie
* T\-SQL en stored procedures
* tSQLt database unit testing
* Query tuning en performance troubleshooting
* Isolation levels en concurrency
* Indexes en indexed views
* Table partitioning
* Data archivering
* Back\-up\-, restore\- en onderhoudsprocessen (o.a. Ola Hallengren)
* Multi\-server administration
* Monitoring met Query Store, sp\_WhoIsActive en Extended Events
* Security, autorisaties en encryptie
* Always On Availability Groups (Enterprise Edition)
* Service Broker
* Full\-Text Search
* Werken met multi\-terabyte databases
* Datawarehousing principes
* PowerShell automatisering
* Azure (IaaS en PaaS)
* GitHub en versiebeheer

  

Daarnaast worden wij extra enthousiast als je beschikt over Microsoft SQL Server\- of Azure\-certificeringen, ervaring hebt binnen een complexe softwareontwikkelomgeving, bekend bent met DevOps en CI/CD\-processen of al hebt gewerkt met AI\-ondersteunde tooling binnen development en beheer.

### **Interesse?**


Ben jij de SQL Server specialist die ervoor zorgt dat onze systemen altijd snel, veilig en beschikbaar blijven? Solliciteer dan direct en word onderdeel van het IT\-team van Monta.

### **Bureaus en derden**


Hee topverkoper!


We weten dat jij DE perfecte kandidaat voor ons hebt! Laten wij nou net het allerbeste HR\-team van Nederland zijn! Wij werven onze nieuwe Monta toppers dan ook he\-le\-maal zelf. Ontzettend bedankt voor je interesse, een belletje/mailtje wordt niet op prijs gesteld. We wensen je een stralende dag toe!

jobs.title: Product Owner Data Platform
jobs.description:
**Product Owner Data Platform** **(Amersfoort)**

ANVA bouwt al meer dan 50 jaar de software waarop de Nederlandse verzekeringsmarkt draait. Meer dan 21 miljoen polissen draaien op ons platform, samen goed voor bijna 60% van het premievolume in de markt. Iedere dag werken meer dan 10\.000 professionals met onze software. Vrijwel elke Nederlander heeft een verzekering die op ANVA draait.

Nu bouwen we de volgende generatie van dat platform en migreren we een groot bestaand klantenbestand hiernaartoe. In al die polissen zit informatie waarmee onze klanten hun bedrijf kunnen sturen. Als Product Owner Data Platform bouw je de propositie die deze informatie toegankelijk en waardevol maakt.

**AI bij ANVA**

ANVA wil het tempo bepalen op het gebied van AI in verzekeringssoftware, niet volgen.

Op het dataplatform maken we die ambitie concreet: AI die patronen in een portefeuille zichtbaar maakt, afwijkingen signaleert voordat klanten ze zelf ontdekken en vragen over de eigen organisatie beantwoordt zonder dat iemand eerst een rapport hoeft te bouwen.

We verwachten dat AI een centraal onderdeel is van hoe je werkt en vragen je om tijdens het sollicitatieproces te laten zien wat je ermee hebt gebouwd.

**Jouw impact**

Je bent eigenaar van het dataplatform waarmee onze klanten inzicht krijgen in hun eigen organisatie, waaronder productiviteit, commerciële resultaten, efficiëntie en portefeuilleprestaties.

Klanten kunnen deze inzichten afnemen via API's, rechtstreeks of via een tussenpartij, en via geïntegreerde BI\-tooling binnen het platform zelf.

Dit is geen ondersteunende laag, maar een propositie op zichzelf, met ruimte om uit te groeien tot een zelfstandig product. Je bepaalt welke inzichten we bieden, hoe klanten erbij komen en waar we geld mee verdienen. Je werkt in een duo met de Engineering Manager, die verantwoordelijk is voor de engineering binnen het team.

**In deze rol**

* Bepaal je de productstrategie en roadmap voor het dataplatform als klantpropositie.
* Bepaal je welke inzichten we leveren op het gebied van productiviteit, commerciële resultaten, efficiëntie en portefeuille\-inzicht.
* Ontwikkel je de manieren waarop klanten die informatie afnemen: via API's, via tussenpartijen en via geïntegreerde BI\-tooling.
* Bouw je de propositie uit tot een zelfstandig product met een eigen verdienmodel.
* Zet je AI in om inzichten te leveren die klanten zelf niet uit hun data zouden halen.
* Werk je samen met commerciële collega's aan positionering, prijsstelling en marktintroductie.

**In je eerste jaar**

* Ligt er een gepubliceerde roadmap voor het dataplatform als propositie, gedragen door Product Management en Commercie.
* Nemen klanten inzichten af via zowel de API als de geïntegreerde BI\-tooling.
* Is ten minste één nieuw inzichtenproduct succesvol in de markt gezet en actief in gebruik.
* Ligt er een onderbouwd verdienmodel voor de propositie.

**Wie je bent**

Je begrijpt dataplatforms én hoe je er een product van maakt dat klanten daadwerkelijk willen kopen. Je bent net zo thuis in een gesprek over datamodellen en API's als in de vraag waar een gevolmachtigd agent of verzekeraar voor wil betalen. Je denkt in proposities, niet in rapporten.

* HBO\- of WO\-werk\- en denkniveau, met aantoonbare ervaring als Product Owner of Product Manager van een dataplatform of dataproduct.
* Ervaring met het vermarkten van data, bijvoorbeeld analytics, BI of data als commerciële propositie.
* Inzicht in hoe klanten data afnemen via API's, tussenpartijen en ingebouwde tooling.
* Voldoende technische diepgang om goede afwegingen te maken met engineering.
* AI staat al centraal in hoe je werkt en je kunt laten zien wat je ermee hebt gebouwd.
* Affiniteit met verzekeren of de financiële sector is een pre.

**Eerlijk over de rol**

De propositie is nog niet volledig uitgewerkt. Er ligt een platform en er is een duidelijke ambitie, maar wat we precies verkopen, aan wie en tegen welke prijs, bepaal jij mede.

Dat betekent dat je een deel van je tijd bezig bent met vragen waarop nog geen antwoord bestaat en dat je zowel commercie als engineering moet meenemen in de keuzes die gemaakt worden.

Deze rol is minder geschikt voor iemand die vooral een bestaande roadmap wil uitvoeren. Wie energie krijgt van het neerzetten van een nieuwe propositie, vindt hier juist veel ruimte en verantwoordelijkheid.

**Waar je terechtkomt**

ANVA ontwikkelt al meer dan 50 jaar software voor de verzekeringsbranche. Wat begon als een initiatief vanuit de sector, is uitgegroeid tot een fintechbedrijf dat dagelijks door meer dan 10\.000 professionals wordt gebruikt.

Met onze software helpen we verzekeraars, gevolmachtigd agenten en adviseurs om miljoenen eindklanten beter te bedienen.

Vanuit onze kantoren in Amersfoort en Bergen op Zoom geven ruim 220 collega's vorm aan de toekomst van financiële dienstverlening met slimme technologie. AI is voor ons geen experiment, maar een kernonderdeel van hoe we het platform bouwen en verbeteren.

Naast technologie maakt vooral onze samenwerking het verschil: over disciplines heen, met eigenaarschap en de ambitie om elke dag beter te worden.

**Wat we bieden**

* Marktconform salaris \+ dertiende maand
* Een tijdelijke workation vanaf een van onze internationale locaties in het Caribisch gebied.
* Een thuiswerkbudget van €750 om je werkplek goed in te richten.
* Een dertiende maand.
* 27,5 vakantiedagen.
* Een premievrij pensioen, volledig betaald door ANVA.
* Opleiding, coaching en internationale doorgroeimogelijkheden.
* Barista\-koffie, verse sappen en vers fruit op kantoor.

**Solliciteer als je**

* Een propositie wilt neerzetten in plaats van een backlog wilt afwerken.
* Data net zo goed begrijpt als klantwaarde en verdienmodellen.
* Trots bent op hoe je met AI werkt en dat graag laat zien.
* Wilt dat duizenden professionals hun organisatie sturen op basis van wat jij bouwt.

**Solliciteer niet als je**

* AI nog geen serieus onderdeel van je werk hebt gemaakt.
* Een uitgewerkte roadmap wilt uitvoeren in plaats van er zelf een te ontwikkelen.
* Liever op afstand blijft van de commerciële kant van het product.
* Volledig op afstand wilt werken.

**Klaar om mee te bouwen?**

Laat het ons weten! Stuur je CV of stuur ons iets dat je met AI hebt gebouwd en help mee het platform verder te ontwikkelen waarop de Nederlandse verzekeringsmarkt draait.

Soort dienstverband: Fulltime, Vaste baan

Salaris: Tot €100\.000,00 per jaar

Arbeidsvoorwaarden:

* Bedrijfsfeesten
* Bedrijfsopleiding
* Budget voor professionele ontwikkeling
* Extra vakantiedagen
* Fietsplan
* Kerstpakket
* Kosteloos parkeren
* Lunchkorting
* Pensioen
* Reiskostenvergoeding
* Vrijdagmiddagborrel

Screeningsvragen:

* Heb je ervaring in een software product organisatie?

Taal:

* Nederlands (Vereist)

Werklocatie: Hybride werken in 3817 Amersfoort

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
As a Senior Software Engineer, you’ll focus on designing and implementing 3D model conversion and checking algorithms while helping guide our transition to a modular, component\-based architecture. If you’re looking for a role that combines technical depth with architectural influence, it’s a strong match.

#### **Who are we**


BIMcollab is a global market leader in BIM quality control and collaboration tools, helping the construction industry build smarter, faster, and more sustainably. Making 3D models run smoothly in the browser is anything but simple. Massive files, fast rendering, real\-time interactions \- users expect it all to work seamlessly.


We empower users to create and maintain high\-quality buildings that are circular, energy efficient, and offer a safe environment. We shape the construction industry by facilitating an integrated BIM process with fast, innovative, and user\-friendly solutions that integrate with all popular BIM tools. Through high\-quality, service\-oriented support, we let our users experience the power and joy of a smooth BIM process.

#### **What you’ll do**


As an engineer of our SaaS platform organization, you will work on core capabilities that are critical to the performance, scalability, and quality of our product. Your focus will be on developing and optimizing complex, performance\-sensitive functionality where accuracy and efficiency are key differentiators for our customers.


You will collaborate in a multidisciplinary, agile setup alongside product, engineering, and quality roles, contributing to both the technical direction and the continuous improvement of our platform.


You will:

* Design and implement performance\-sensitive core platform functionality
* Develop and optimize 3D model conversion and validation algorithms
* Contribute to the transition toward a modular, cloud\-enabled architecture
* Work across desktop and cloud environments (Azure, Windows, Mac)
* Mentor and support fellow engineers while ensuring best practices are applied
* Balance new feature development with long\-term technical improvements
* Keep a strong focus on security, quality, and delivered business value

**Our tech stack**


Backend: mostly C\#, with some C\+\+  

Frontend: VueJS, React  

Cloud: Azure

#### **What we offer**


You’ll join a team with international impact and work on a platform used by some of the world’s largest construction companies. You can expect:

* A competitive salary of 4\.900 \- €7\.000 based on experience
* 27 vacation days \+ option to buy extra days
* Strong benefits package including a generous pension scheme
* Green benefits (e.g. home sustainability reimbursements, bike scheme)
* €1,500 annual learning budget \+ room for personal and professional growth
* Hybrid work: 2 days per week at the office in the heart of Eindhoven
* A nearly energy\-neutral office environment
* Monthly home\-office allowance
* Up to 4 weeks per year fully remote from abroad
* Daily catered lunch and fresh fruit

#### **What you bring**

* You have 5\+ years software engineering and have strong knowledge of computer science fundamentals, including algorithms, data structures, and performance.
* You have good knowledge of and experience using, Design Patterns, SOLID principles and TDD and you value an agile mindset.
* You have a proven record of working with large\-scale applications.
* You can mentor and help other Engineers grow or you would like to develop these skills.
* You thrive in a highly collaborative environment where innovation and initiative is valued.
* You have a learning mindset and continually research best practices and new tooling.

**Bonus points**

* You have experience with software optimization and algorithms.
* Knowledge and experience in 3D technology or BIM.
* Knowledge and experience in component based development and API\-first development.

#### **The work environment**


Our engineering team consists of over 40 Engineers, Testers, and Product Owners, divided over six Scrum teams. Our development team is diverse and international (we have over 20 nationalities!), and our working language is English.

  

At BIMcollab, we strive for an inclusive and diverse work environment where everyone is welcome, regardless of their background, gender, age, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion, or disability. We encourage applicants with diverse perspectives and backgrounds to apply and believe in equal opportunities for all. We value the unique contributions that each employee can make and are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone is respected and appreciated.

#### **Interested? We’d love to meet you!**


Do you recognize yourself in the above? Then apply immediately! Do you want to know more? Then take a look around at www.bimcollab.com. For questions, you can always call us at \+31 (0\)40 213 1950\.


Acquisition in response to this vacancy is not appreciated.

jobs.title: IT Internship - Fullstack Engineer: Modernizing Enterprise Frontends with React & .NET
jobs.description:
***IT Internship \- Modernizing Enterprise Frontends with React \& .NET***

***Becoming an IT professional that you aspire to be***

**About the Internship**


Swisscom is always keen on attracting and developing the best talents. As part of the leading telecom and tech company in Switzerland, you will work on real projects that have real impact. From day one, you will be part of an international team collaborating across Switzerland, Rotterdam, and Riga, contributing to innovative solutions in Swisscom’s digital transformation. This means working hands‑on in backend, cloud, or full‑stack development, applying your Computer Science skills to real technical challenges.


With colleagues from over 60 nationalities, diversity is not just something we value, it is how we work. We believe in open collaboration, ownership, and continuous learning. You will be encouraged to share ideas, take initiative, and grow within the environment. We respect each other, help each other out, and are not afraid to make mistakes. We make sure you can be the best version of yourself.


Our internship program startson **1st** **February 2027**. In this **6 months internship** you will work in agile teams using Scrum and SAFe, gaining hands\-on experience in a fast\-paced and supportive environment.

**About the Internship Project:**

**Modernizing Enterprise Frontends with React \& .NET**


Join our agile engineering team to reshape mission\-critical platforms! You’ll research and drive high\-impact frontend migrations within a robust Modular Monolith architecture. Work hands\-on with modern React, TypeScript, and .NET Web APIs, leveraging CI/CD DevOps pipelines, Microservices integration, and enterprise Security standards. Ideal for an ambitious developer ready to solve real\-world architectural challenges and make a lasting impact!

 **Must\-haves:** TypeScript; JavaScript; C\#; .NET; React
  

**Nice\-to\-haves:** Git; DB; UX/UI; AWS; Kafka

**Who are you?**

* You are a student enrolled in the **last year** of your HBO or University program in the field of Computer Science, Informatica, or any other similar field.
* You **live in the** **Netherlands.**
* You are willing to contribute to an international team and you have an agile mindset.
* You are curious and responsible.
* You have a good level of English; any other language is a plus.  

**Please note that for non\-EU students, it is necessary to provide the NUFFIC Agreement for the 6\-month internship from your university in order to be eligible.**

 **Perks**

* 810 € gross Monthly Allowance (Full time)
* IT Equipment
* Agile working environment and lean management instructor
* Flexible working time model
* Plenty of opportunities for training and personal development
* International Environment
* Holidays \& time off

 **Contact**


Do you have any questions or do you want to know why we love working at Swisscom? Feel free to reach out to Lilla Egyed (lilla.egyed@swisscom.com) or María Baker (Maria.BakerEnguidanos@swisscom.com).


**Please, submit your CV in English.**

jobs.title: Senior Software Developer (.NET / Azure)
jobs.description:
As a **Senior Software Developer** at UAB\-Online, you play a key role in the continued development and modernization of our SaaS platform. Our software connects terminals, vessel operators, and supply chain partners worldwide, helping them collaborate more efficiently across liquid and dry bulk operations.


You **design, build, and improve** scalable enterprise applications within a modern Microsoft ecosystem. In addition to delivering new functionality, you contribute to architectural decisions, strengthen our engineering practices, and help reduce technical debt. You combine **strong software engineering skills** with a **practical mindset** and take **ownership** of your work from concept through production.


In this role, you work closely with developers, Product Owners, UX, QA, Cloud, and other colleagues. You enjoy **solving complex technical challenges**, sharing knowledge, and continuously improving the way software is designed, tested, and delivered. You will also have the opportunity to explore how AI\-assisted development and coding agents can improve both our development process and our product.

### **What you can expect**


As a Senior Software Developer, your work combines **hands\-on** development with technical improvement and collaboration. One moment you may be designing and implementing a new feature, while the next you are reviewing code, improving a deployment pipeline, or working with colleagues on the modernization of an existing part of the platform.


You can expect a role in which you have visible impact, contribute to technical decisions, and help shape the future of a business\-critical platform used by maritime organizations around the world.


Your work will include:

* **Designing**, **building**, and **enhancing** enterprise SaaS applications using **C\# and .NET**
* Taking **ownership** of features from initial concept through development and production
* Contributing to the modernization of our platform and the continued development of its architecture
* Building reliable, scalable, and maintainable solutions using **Clean Architecture** and **SOLID** principles
* **Reviewing** **code** and promoting software engineering best practices
* Developing and improving **CI/CD pipelines** and deployment processes
* Implementing automated testing throughout the development lifecycle
* Working with **Azure** cloud services and modern **DevOps** tooling
* Exploring and introducing **AI\-assisted development** workflows and coding agents
* Collaborating with Product, UX, QA, Cloud, and Frontend colleagues
* Identifying opportunities to reduce technical debt and improve delivery efficiency⁠

  

For this role, we are looking for an **experienced** software developer who **combines strong technical expertise with ownership, curiosity, and a collaborative mindset**. You are comfortable working on both new functionality and existing systems, and you enjoy contributing to long\-term technical improvements.


In general, we look for:

* **Ownership**: you take responsibility for your work, follow through, and actively look for ways to improve results
* **Genuine communication**: you communicate openly and respectfully, listen well, and say what you mean
* **Collaboration**: you share knowledge, ask for input, support others, and help the team make better decisions faster
* Experience working in an **Agile environment**
* Ability to work effectively in a **cross\-functional team** while also being comfortable working **independently**
* **Adaptability** in a dynamic environment with changing priorities
* A proactive approach to **problem\-solving** and continuous improvement
* **Integrity** and **professionalism** when working with business\-critical systems and information
* Comfortable working in an **ISO\-certified environment, including ISO 27001 and ISO 9001**, and following agreed processes for quality, security, and continuous improvement


For the Senior Software Developer role, we additionally value:

* Strong professional experience with **C\#, .NET, ASP.NET, and Entity Framework**
* Experience building and maintaining enterprise\-scale applications
* Strong knowledge of **Clean Architecture**, SOLID principles, and software design patterns
* Experience modernizing legacy systems and **improving** existing platforms
* **Hands\-on** experience with **Microsoft Azure** and modern CI/CD practices
* Experience with **automated testing** and software quality practices
* An interest in **AI\-assisted software development** or AI\-powered applications
* **Strong communication skills** and a **collaborative** approach to software engineering
* The ability to make **well\-considered technical decisions** and explain them to others
* Full professional **proficiency in English**, both spoken and written


Experience with the following is **considered a plus:**

* Maritime, logistics, or supply chain environments
* Microsoft SQL Server
* Vue.js
* Kubernetes
* Advanced Microsoft Azure services
* Working closely with Product Owners and Agile product teams

### **Working at UAB\-Online**


This vacancy gives you an impression of the role itself. If you would like to learn more about our team, culture, benefits, office, and hiring process, you can find more information on our careers page.

*\*\*We are handling the recruitment for this vacancy ourselves and are not working with external recruitment agencies for this role. Acquisition in response to this vacancy is therefore not appreciated. Unsolicited profiles or proposals will not be considered.\*\**

jobs.title: Full Stack Developer
Senior Fullstack Developer
jobs.description:
**In het kort**
---------------


Ben jij een senior fullstack developer die zich net zo thuis voelt in de back\-end als in de front\-end en DevOps als een integraal onderdeel van het vak ziet? Via ICT TriOpSys werk je binnen het veiligheidsdomein aan een 24/7 missiekritisch intelligencesysteem. Je bent betrokken bij het volledige traject: van architectuur en ontwerp tot doorontwikkeling, onderhoud, beheer en productie.

**Dit vind je leuk om te doen**
-------------------------------

* Ontwerpen, ontwikkelen, onderhouden en beheren van een missie kritische systemen dat 24/7 beschikbaar moet zijn
* Bouwen aan gebruiksvriendelijke en toegankelijke front\-ends en betrouwbare back\-enddiensten, met aandacht voor prestaties, veiligheid en continuïteit
* Beschikbaar maken van informatie uit verschillende gegevensbronnen, zodat operationele gebruikers snel, veilig en eenvoudig de juiste informatie kunnen vinden
* Verantwoordelijkheid nemen voor het volledige ontwikkeltraject, van architectuur en ontwerp tot deployment en de operationele werking in productie
* Continu verbeteren van softwarekwaliteit, CI/CD\-pipelines, testautomatisering en de samenwerking tussen development en operations
* Samenwerken in een multidisciplinair DevOps\-team met engineers, IT\-experts en operationele professionals volgens Agile en Scrum
* Benutten van de expertise van ondersteunende teams om veilige softwareontwikkeling, deployment en operations verder te verbeteren
* Verkennen van nieuwe technologieën, delen van verbeterideeën en begeleiden van minder ervaren collega’s

**Hier herken je jezelf in**
----------------------------

* Je hebt hbo\-bachelor werk\- en denkniveau, bij voorkeur in de richting van softwareontwikkeling
* Minimaal 5 jaar werkervaring als software developer met Java 17 of hoger en Spring Boot
* Ruime ervaring met werken in Agile\-, Continuous Delivery\- en DevOps\-omgevingen
* Front\-endervaring met Angular, TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3 (SCSS), JavaScript, responsive design, unit\- en E2E\-tests, state management en component\-based development. Je ontwikkelt gebruiksvriendelijke en toegankelijke interfaces
* Je hebt back\-endervaring met Java, Kotlin, Spring Boot 4, REST/JSON, Reactive Programming, objectoriëntatie en datastructuren
* Ervaring met OpenShift/Kubernetes, ArgoCD, GitLab\-pipelines, Docker/Podman Compose, Linux, Bash, Python, Infrastructure as Code en configuratiebeheer
* Je hebt ervaring met PostgreSQL, Elasticsearch, Kafka en S3
* Ervaring met Maven, Nexus, Sonar, Keycloak, Matomo, OAuth, OWASP, networking en security
* Je hebt aantoonbare ervaring met Test Driven Development (TDD) en testautomatisering

**Wie zijn wij?**
-----------------


Als specialist in mission critical IT helpt ICT TriOpSys organisaties waar security en continuïteit er toe doen. Van het geven van advies tot de bouw en het beheer van bedrijfskritische systemen: ICT TriOpSys is dé partner in de sectoren Defence \& Aerospace, Public Safety \& Security en Traffic Management. Wij geloven in maatwerk, iedere klant is uniek, en staan bekend om onze domeinkennis en 24/7 service.**Wat bieden wij?**
-------------------

* Leaseauto of mobiliteitsvergoeding: kies wat bij jou past
* 13e maand: 8,33% extra per maand, of jaarlijks in december uitbetaald
* Vakantiegeld: 8% van je bruto jaarsalaris uitbetaald in mei
* 29 vakantiedagen: met de mogelijkheid om tot 9 dagen bij of te verkopen
* Internetvergoeding: € 50,\- netto per maand
* Telefoonregeling: een budget van € 675,\- voor de aanschaf van een telefoon
* Thuiswerkplek: budget om je werkplek thuis in te richten
* Vitaliteit: korting op je sport abonnement
* Hybride werkvorm: een goede balans tussen thuiswerken en samenwerken op locatie

jobs.description:
**Wil jij bouwen aan de supply chain van de toekomst?**


Krijg jij energie van complexe logistieke vraagstukken, het verbeteren van processen en projecten die zichtbaar resultaat opleveren? En ligt jouw kracht in projectmanagement, data\-analyse óf WMS/ERP\-systemen? Dan is deze rol iets voor jou.


Bij Technische Unie werken we continu aan de automatisering en digitalisering van onze supply chain. Als Supply Chain Engineer krijg je veel ruimte om vanuit jouw eigen expertise bij te dragen. Je hoeft dus niet alles al te kunnen: we zoeken iemand die sterk is in minimaal één van deze richtingen en zich graag verder wil ontwikkelen.

**Dit ga je doen**
------------------


Als Supply Chain Engineer werk je op het snijvlak van logistiek, techniek, IT en procesverbetering. Je analyseert waar processen slimmer en efficiënter kunnen en vertaalt complexe vraagstukken naar concrete verbeteringen.


Afhankelijk van jouw ervaring en expertise ligt jouw focus bijvoorbeeld op het doelgericht aansturen van projecten, het analyseren en vertalen van grote hoeveelheden data of het verbeteren en vernieuwen van onze logistieke systemen.


Je werkt samen met collega’s uit verschillende disciplines en maakt deel uit van het Supply Chain Engineering Team: een ambitieus en multidisciplinair team dat werkt aan automatisering, digitalisering en robotisering binnen onze supply chain.

 **Jouw verantwoordelijkheden**

* Analyseren en verbeteren van supply chain\-processen en ondersteunende systemen.
* Vertalen van data en complexe vraagstukken naar inzichten en concrete verbetervoorstellen.
* Opstellen van businesscases en onderbouwen van verbeterinitiatieven.
* Leiden of ondersteunen van projecten binnen onze logistieke operatie.
* Bewaken van voortgang, planning, budget en risico’s.
* Verbinden van collega’s, afdelingen en externe partijen en zorgen voor duidelijke afspraken en opvolging.
* Begeleiden van de implementatie en borging van nieuwe processen en systemen.
* Adviseren over logistieke automatisering, digitalisering en procesoptimalisatie.

 **Waarom deze rol?**


Bij Technische Unie krijg je de ruimte om mee te bouwen aan een van de meest innovatieve supply chains van Nederland. De komende jaren staan er grote ontwikkelingen op de planning, waaronder de verdere vernieuwing van onze logistieke systemen.


Je krijgt veel verantwoordelijkheid en kunt vanuit jouw eigen expertise echt impact maken. Of jouw kracht nu ligt in projectmanagement, data\-analyse of systemen: jouw ideeën worden gehoord en kunnen direct bijdragen aan het verbeteren van onze logistieke operatie.

**Wij bieden**
--------------


Jouw ontwikkeling, gezondheid en veiligheid staan centraal. Als Top Employer bieden we veel goede arbeidsvoorwaarden zoals:

* Geniet van 40 verlofdagen (vakantie\- én ATV\-dagen op fulltime basis) én de optie om dagen te kopen of verkopen

* Blijf vitaal met een vitaliteitsbudget, thuiswerkregeling, sportschoolkorting en gezondheidschecks
* Altijd blijven groeien met ons brede trainings\- en opleidingsaanbod

**Heb jij het in je?**

Lef, durf en aanpassingsvermogen! Dat is de mentaliteit waarmee onze collega’s het verschil maken. Of je nu net begint of al wat ervaring meebrengt, bij Technische Unie krijg je de ruimte om te ontwikkelen op jouw manier.


Iedereen brengt iets unieks mee. Juist die mix van verschillen maakt ons sterker als team. We geloven in een werksfeer waarin je jezelf kunt zijn, kunt groeien en elke dag iets nieuws kunt ontdekken.


Met meer dan 2\.000 collega’s bouwen we dagelijks aan een slimmer, duurzamer Nederland. We helpen onze klanten vooruit met een breed aanbod technische producten, diensten en een krachtige online omgeving die behoort tot de grootste B2B\-platforms van Nederland. Maar het echte verschil maken we met elkaar, met mensen die energie, ideeën en lef meebrengen. Heb jij het in je?

jobs.title: Senior Fullstack Java Engineer
jobs.description:
**Ready for a challenge?**
--------------------------

  

Then Just Eat Takeaway.com might be the place for you. We’re a leading global online delivery platform, and our vision is to empower everyday convenience.


Whether it’s a Friday\-night feast, a post\-gym poke bowl, or grabbing some groceries, our tech platform connects tens of millions of customers with hundreds of thousands of restaurant, grocery and convenience partners across the globe.

**About this role**
-------------------

  

We are seeking a motivated and experienced engineer to join our team as we consolidate fragmented partner data into a global event\-driven architecture. You'll help build tooling that empowers our operations team to manage restaurant partners, breaking down monolithic .NET applications into microservices using Java Spring Framework and Kubernetes. We are big on communication, collaboration and innersourcing across teams.

* ***Please note that this position is located in Amsterdam (3 days a week from our Amsterdam office and 2 days working from home)***

**These are some of the key components to the position:**
---------------------------------------------------------

  

* Design and implement high\-performance, highly scalable, event\-driven microservices for the partner domain.
* Partner with product teams to translate requirements into technical specifications, and align with cross\-functional teams on API/Event contracts (e.g., OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, Confluent).
* Write clean, efficient, and well\-documented code while actively mentoring junior developers and driving code reviews to ensure system maintainability.
* Maintain, investigate, and document the revenue\-driving legacy platform, acting quickly to debug and resolve any operational issues.
* Proactively explore emerging technologies and AI\-driven tools to automate repetitive tasks, simplify full\-stack complexities, and elevate overall code quality.
* Actively participate in team brainstorming sessions, communicate progress on complex features, and remain open to learning and innersourcing across new tech stacks.

**What will you bring to the team?**
------------------------------------

  

* In\-depth knowledge of backend ecosystems (Java/Spring Framework OR C\#/.Net) and design patterns, with expertise building event\-driven microservices using message queues (e.g., Apache Kafka, AWS SNS/SQS).
* Experience in full\-stack development, including proficiency in modern front\-end frameworks (such as Vue, React, etc.).
* Hands\-on experience with AWS, CI/CD pipelines, Docker, Kubernetes, and Helm charts, alongside working knowledge of relational (MySQL) and NoSQL databases.
* Strong background in modern frontend and backend testing frameworks (e.g., JUnit, Testcontainers) and distributed tracing for microservices (e.g., OpenTelemetry, Datadog).
* Hands\-on experience with Amazon Web Services (AWS), DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, Docker, Kubernetes, and Helm charts.
* Familiarity with PHP, broad exposure across multiple backend ecosystems (Java, .NET), and experience with cybersecurity practices.

**At JET, this is how we play**
-------------------------------

  

Our teams forge connections internally and work with some of the best\-known brands on the planet, giving us truly international impact in a dynamic environment.


Being the best at what we do isn’t just about delivering on our strategy. It's a competition for something incredibly valuable – our customers' choice. Every time a customer decides where to order, they're picking a side.

  

At the heart of the JET Customer League are our values and behaviours. They guide every interaction, every decision, every innovation. These are the actions we need to perform consistently and brilliantly, to surpass the competition and earn our customers’ loyalty, again and again.


Fun, fast\-paced and supportive, the JET culture is about movement, growth, helping one another to succeed and celebrating wins. By truly living our values and embodying our behaviours, we’re building a customer\-first culture which enables us to stay one step ahead of the competition.

**Inclusion, Diversity \& Belonging**

jobs.title: Automation Engineer
jobs.description:
Robotica, MES, SCADA, Digital Twins en slimme productiesystemen. Bij VDL Weweler werk je niet aan een theoretisch automatiseringsvraagstuk, maar aan een moderne productieomgeving waar jouw oplossingen direct zichtbaar zijn op de werkvloer.Onze fabriek in Apeldoorn behoort tot de meest geautomatiseerde productielocaties binnen VDL. Hier spelen robotica, data en procesautomatisering een cruciale rol in de productie van luchtveersystemen voor trucks, trailers en bussen die wereldwijd worden ingezet. Als Automation Engineer krijg je de kans om bestaande systemen verder te ontwikkelen en een belangrijke rol te spelen in nieuwe automatiseringsprojecten.
Wat ga je doen?


Als Automation Engineer ben je verantwoordelijk voor het verbeteren, ontwikkelen en ondersteunen van onze industriële automatiseringssystemen. Je werkt op het snijvlak van engineering, IT en productie en hebt direct invloed op de prestaties van onze fabriek. Je houdt je onder andere bezig met:

* Het optimaliseren van onze procesbesturing, waaronder MES\-, SCADA\- en PLC\-systemen
* Het ontwikkelen en verbeteren van robotica\-oplossingen binnen de productieomgeving
* Het initiëren, begeleiden en documenteren van automatiserings\- en verbeterprojecten
* Het testen van nieuwe functionaliteiten binnen een Digital Twin omgeving
* Het analyseren en verhelpen van storingen aan PLC\-, robot\-, SCADA\- en MES\-systemen
* Het ondersteunen van productie en technische dienst bij vraagstukken op het gebied van besturings\-, meet\- en regeltechniek


Wie ben jij?


Je bent nieuwsgierig, analytisch en krijgt energie van het verbeteren van techniek en processen. Je schakelt gemakkelijk tussen projecten en operationele vraagstukken en voelt je thuis in een productieomgeving waar automatisering, technologie en samenwerking samenkomen. Ook herken je jezelf in onderstaande punten:

* Een afgeronde hbo\- of wo\-opleiding richting Industriële Automatisering, Elektrotechniek, Mechatronica of vergelijkbaar
* Goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal
* Ervaring met of interesse in industriële automatisering
* Kennis van of affiniteit met Siemens S7/TIA Portal, MES\- en SCADA\-systemen, ABB RobotStudio of productieautomatisering


Heb je niet overal ervaring mee, maar wel de motivatie om jezelf hierin verder te ontwikkelen? Dan gaan we ook graag met je in gesprek.


De kracht van VDL


Bij VDL Weweler ontwikkelen, produceren en verkopen we innovatieve luchtveer\- en asliftsystemen voor de internationale automotive industrie. Onze producten worden wereldwijd toegepast door toonaangevende fabrikanten van trucks, trailers en bussen. In onze fabriek hebben we een modern productieproces waarin automatisering, digitalisering en continue verbetering altijd centraal staan. We investeren volop in nieuwe technologieën en ook in onze mensen. Je komt terecht in een informele organisatie met korte lijnen, veel vrijheid en collega's die net als jij graag bouwen aan slimme technische oplossingen. Werken bij VDL Weweler betekent werken aan technologie die ertoe doet. Daar staat natuurlijk ook iets tegenover:

* Salaris tussen de €4\.300 en €6\.000 bruto per maand, afhankelijk van jouw kennis en ervaring
* Volop opleidings\- en ontwikkelmogelijkheden
* Een goede pensioenregeling volgens de cao Metalektro
* 27 vakantiedagen en 13 ADV\-dagen
* Jaarlijkse winstdeling
* Collectieve voordelen via VDL
* Een uitdagende functie voor 32 tot 40 uur per week
* De mogelijkheid om gebruik te maken van het VDL\-fietsplan
* Leuke personeelsactiviteiten, sportevenementen en het jaarlijkse VDL\-feest


Een kijkje achter de schermen bij


https://www.youtube.com/embed/QBFm2hqW3Wo?si\=ZBbNXmaemFhSWl8I


Klaar om jezelf uit te dagen?

Bedankt voor je begrip en interesse in VDL Groep.

At Colibrium Additive, a GE Aerospace company, we work every day to bring the transformative power of additive manufacturing to businesses around the globe.  

  

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer (Signal \& Image Processing) to join our team in Lichtenfels, Germany. In this role, you will design, build, deliver, and maintain software and sensor applications that are part of our additive manufacturing machines.  

  

Your main focus will be on process monitoring solutions for laser\-based additive machines, contributing to print documentation, anomaly detection, and process stabilization. This is a great opportunity for someone who combines strong software engineering skills with deep expertise in camera systems, imaging, and signal processing.  

  

This role is based in Lichtenfels, Germany and we offer a hybrid working model with up to two home\-office days per week.**Job Description**
===================

**What you’ll do**

* Design and implement complex software features and systems for additive manufacturing applications
* Develop and maintain software using .NET, Python, and Node.js
* Drive solutions related to camera integration, imaging, frame grabbers, data transfer, image normalization, calibration, and resolution
* Contribute to architecture decisions, coding standards, and engineering best practices
* Support hardware selection and performance evaluation to ensure system requirements are met
* Collaborate with product managers, hardware teams, manufacturing, and additive engineering teams

* Experience in industrial, manufacturing, or additive / 3D printing environments

We’re a global, multi\-disciplinary team that’s putting the innovative power of technology to work and transforming tomorrow. At HARMAN Corporate, you are integral to our company’s award\-winning success.

This role requires strong expertise in cloud platforms, platform engineering, security, and production AI operations to ensure platform reliability, scalability, and governance. You will work closely with architects, product owners, and engineering teams to deliver robust platform capabilities that accelerate enterprise AI adoption.

* Contribute to platform documentation, technical standards, reusable assets, and engineering best practices.

* Develop, deploy, and maintain enterprise AI platform components, services, APIs, and integrations that support AI applications and agent\-based solutions.

* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines, automation frameworks, and deployment processes supporting AI workloads and platform services.
* Perform testing, validation, and operational readiness assessments for platform modules, services, and integrations.
**What Makes You A Strong Fit**


* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field, with 6\+ years of experience in platform engineering, cloud engineering, software engineering, or related disciplines.
* Strong experience developing and operating cloud\-native platforms using Microsoft Azure, AWS, or similar enterprise cloud environments.
* Hands\-on experience with MLOps, LLMOps, CI/CD automation, infrastructure\-as\-code, containerization, and production deployment practices.
* Strong understanding of platform security, identity and access management, observability, monitoring, and security\-by\-design principles.
* Knowledge of data governance, enterprise integration patterns, APIs, and scalable platform architectures supporting AI and data\-driven solutions.
**Bonus Points if You Have**


* Experience supporting enterprise AI platforms, agent\-based systems, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), or generative AI workloads.
* Certifications in Azure, AWS, Kubernetes, DevOps, Security, or related cloud technologies.
* Experience with vector databases, AI orchestration frameworks, model serving platforms, and modern AI development ecosystems.
* Experience working in large, global organizations with distributed engineering and operations teams.
**Things To Know**

jobs.description:
**Senior Product Engineer \- Investments**

**About Kota**


Kota is reimagining insurance and retirement benefits for the modern workforce. Through our two flagship products \- Kota Platform, the first fully integrated benefits platform, and Kota Embed, our embedded insurance solution \- we're making benefits more accessible, valued, and global.


Today, we power benefits for tens of thousands of employees at Europe's most forward\-thinking companies, including Carwow, Tines, Zoe, and Remote. Founded in 2022, we've raised more than €20M from leading investors such as EQT Ventures, Eurazeo, Northzone, and Frontline, as well as founders and executives from Workday, Remote, Personio, OpenAI, and more.

 **The role \& team**


We're looking for a Senior Product Engineer to join the Investments team, building the product that powers workplace pensions, retirement savings and our spend product at Kota. It's a full stack role with a backend lean, your strongest expertise will be backend and you'll work in the frontend when the product needs it.


The Investments team owns more than pensions. On one side, pension infrastructure is genuinely complex: multi\-provider, multi\-market and largely unmodernised. You'll design the systems that connect pension providers to employers and employees, covering contributions, fund data, payroll integrations and compliance across multiple markets.


On the other hand, you'll own our Spend product. This lets employers create allowances and issue cards to employees, who get a virtual Stripe card they can add to Apple or Google Wallet and spend in real time. It spans card issuing, wallet provisioning, transaction flows and the controls employers need to manage it. We want someone who starts with the customer, not the code, and proactively adds to the roadmap rather than just picking up tickets. This is an autonomous role, you'll be trusted to make product calls, not just technical ones.

 **What you'll do**

* Design and build the systems that power Kota's Investments products; pensions, retirement savings and Spend: contributions, onboarding, provider integrations, employer\-facing configuration, card issuing and wallet provisioning
* Own technical architecture for the Investments stream, integrating with external pension and savings providers as well as payment and card infrastructure (Stripe)
* Contribute to frontend code (React \+ TypeScript) when a feature calls for it
* Join client calls where it helps you understand or explain a problem, and proactively shape the roadmap rather than just picking up tickets
* Use AI actively in your day\-to\-day work, for building, reviewing and speeding up how you ship
* Contribute to code reviews and technical planning, and keep the systems you own stable and observable
* Help shape how the Investments team works as it grows

 **What we're looking for**

* 6\+ years building backend systems in production (.NET 10, PostgreSQL, Azure/AWS), comfortable picking up frontend (React/TypeScript) when needed
* Experience designing and maintaining integrations with third\-party APIs
* Strong understanding of data modelling, event\-driven patterns, and building for correctness and auditability
* A clear communicator who can talk to engineers and customers, and knows which version to use with which audience
* A product mindset and a bias to bring ideas, not just execute them, proactively adding to the roadmap
* You take real ownership, if a request from a client or lead doesn't match your own understanding of the problem, you say so rather than building to spec anyway
* You think carefully about reliability, security and compliance, and are comfortable with ambiguity and ownership in a fast\-growing startup
* AI\-forward mindset, we use AI daily to build and improve our systems and expect you to as well

 **Why join us?**

* **Technically interesting problem** \- pension infrastructure is genuinely complex: multi\-provider, multi\-market and largely unmodernised
* **Modern stack** \- .NET 10, PostgreSQL, React, TypeScript, Next.js, Azure/AWS, event\-driven
* **Agency** \- we hire people and trust them. You'll own meaningful parts of the system end to end
* **Customer proximity** \- you'll see the impact of what you build, and hear directly from the people using it
* **High\-quality culture** \- we care about clean design and thoughtful engineering
* **Impact from day one** \- we're a small, focused team. What you build ships fast and matters
* **AI\-first** \- we invest heavily in AI tooling and token usage. We're not precious about the spend, if it helps you build better or faster, use it

 **Our hiring process**

* **Introductory call (30 mins):** a casual chat with one or two of our product team
* **Technical interview (90 mins):** a collaborative, open\-book session with two engineers, working through a real\-world problem together
* **Call with founders (30 mins):** we'll share our vision and hear your thoughts
* **Final response:** we'll follow up promptly with next steps

 **Kota benefits**

* Health insurance via Kota
* Workplace pension with matched contributions up to 5% via Kota
* WFH stipend to support your home office setup
* Generous paid time off, work hard and take the time you need
* Access to office space in Dublin or a co\-working space, wherever you're based
* Flexible working hours, we're remote\-first with some fixed hours for team alignment


We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

jobs.description:
**About Airwallex**
-------------------


Airwallex is the only unified payments and financial platform for global businesses. Powered by our unique combination of proprietary infrastructure and software, we empower over 250,000 businesses worldwide – including Brex, Navan, Qantas, SHEIN and many more – with fully integrated solutions to manage everything from business accounts, payments, spend management and treasury, to embedded finance at a global scale.


Proudly founded in Melbourne, we have a team of over 2,300 of the brightest and most innovative people in tech across 27 offices around the globe. Valued at US$11 billion and backed by world\-leading investors including T. Rowe Price, Visa, Mastercard, Robinhood Ventures, Sequoia, Salesforce Ventures, DST Global, and Lone Pine Capital, Airwallex is leading the charge in building the global payments and financial platform of the future. If you’re ready to do the most ambitious work of your career, join us.

  

**Attributes We Value**
-----------------------


We hire successful builders with founder\-like energy who want real impact, accelerated learning, and true ownership. You bring strong role\-related expertise and sharp thinking, and you’re motivated by our mission and operating principles. You move fast with good judgment, dig deep with curiosity, and make decisions from first principles, balancing speed and rigor.


You're humble and collaborative; turn zero‑to‑one ideas into real products, and you “get stuff done” end\-to\-end. You use AI to work smarter and solve problems faster. Here, you’ll tackle complex, high‑visibility problems with exceptional teammates and grow your career as we build the future of global banking. If that sounds like you, let’s build what’s next.

 **Who We Are**


Airwallex is a technology company that revolutionises the way businesses operate globally. Our financial infrastructure provides a modern technology stack for businesses to operate internationally, without the challenges of the current global financial system.


Businesses use Airwallex as their end\-to\-end global financial services platform. Whether it’s making or receiving payments from customers, domestically or internationally, Airwallex saves businesses time and money by offering real\-time, reliable and cost\-effective financial solutions. Our web and API solutions support businesses of all sizes, from small companies to large enterprises.


In this fast\-changing digital world that is increasingly becoming borderless, our mission is to empower businesses of all sizes to grow in their own markets and around the world, and by doing so, contribute to the global economy.

**You Will**

* Bachelor's degree or above in Computer Science or relevant majors
* Proven years of working experience in either programming, technical support, implementation or relevant jobs.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, able to communicate clearly and appropriately with internal and customers.
* Strong troubleshooting and problem\-solving skills
* Prioritisation, organisation and detail oriented on ticket handling, able to work on multiple urgent issues in parallel.
* Must have sufficient technical knowledge to communicate with Engineering and Product teams
* Strong willingness to provide exceptional customer service
* Demonstrated quick learning of technology and new products
* Experienced in the e\-commerce, payment, fintech industry is a plus

**Technical Skills:**

* Experience in one of the programming languages: Python, Java, php, C\#, Java Script or shell scripting
* Familiarity with Web Technologies, HTTP and HTTPS

All official communication will come from an @**airwallex.com* *email address. Please apply only through* *careers.airwallex.com* *or our official LinkedIn page.*

jobs.title: Full Stack Engineer
jobs.description:
**What is Digital Speed?**

Digital Speed is a full\-service product and engineering agency delivering strategy, design, and development for global clients. Our expertise spans Brand, Discovery, UX/UI, and Full\-Stack Engineering, alongside product strategy and marketing. We partner with organisations in finance, automotive, sport, and technology to ship dependable, high\-quality outcomes at scale.We are driven by 4 key values:

* Open – We arrive with options, welcome feedback, and find the best way forward together.
* Thriving – New challenges energise us; we learn and improve as a team.
* Experts – Specialists who care about their craft and deliver results with structure.
* Caring – We take our clients’ goals as seriously as our own and build trusted relationships.

**Where do you fit in?**

You'll join as a full\-stack engineer in London, working closely with agency leadership and a client teams to build various products. Your main account will include a product aimed at engineers and AI coding agents. You'll shape high\-quality engineering practices, reusable components, strong pipelines, production\-ready software while owning the parts of the product that determine whether developers and agents actually succeed with it: documentation, onboarding, and sandbox testing. This is a role for someone who enjoys breadth and ownership: context\-switching across languages, designing for both human and machine consumers, and collaborating across agency and client teams.

**Responsibilities**

* **Core Engineering:** Design and build robust, reusable services and libraries across multiple languages (Java, .NET, Python, TypeScript, Go), for a product consumed by both developers and AI coding agents.
* **Documentation:** Build and maintain a docs\-as\-code platform \- API references, quickstarts, and guides \- structured for both human readability and machine parsing (OpenAPI/JSON Schema, MCP tool definitions, llms.txt where relevant).
* **Onboarding:** Design and build the onboarding path from signup to first successful integration \- CLI/SDK scaffolding, guided setup, and error handling clear enough for an agent to self\-correct on, not just a human.
* **Sandbox Testing:** Build isolated sandbox environments \- mock services, seeded test data, ephemeral instances \- where engineers and agents can safely test integrations without touching production.
* **Architecture \& Review:** Analyse requirements, propose technical approaches, and lead peer reviews to maintain high standards.
* **CI/CD \& Quality Gates:** Implement and refine pipelines with linting, tests/coverage, artifact signing, and versioning discipline.
* **Release Management:** Ensure clean, traceable, secure releases across environments, with strong changelog hygiene — especially important where agents consume versioned APIs programmatically.
* **Collaboration \& Handover:** Work directly with the client's Architecture/Platform teams; produce documentation, run\-books, and recorded walkthroughs as part of agency delivery.
* **Continuous Improvement:** Optimise build times, automate repeatable tasks, and keep outputs deterministic and reproducible.

**Characteristics**

* **Simplify:** Turn messy requirements into clear, repeatable systems \- and clear systems into documentation that needs no follow\-up questions.
* **High\-performance:** Care about reliability, observability, and regression safety.
* **Collaborative:** Give/receive reviews; document decisions; unblock others.
* **First\-principles:** Handle ambiguity and make trade\-offs explicit.
* **Ownership:** Proactive, organised, and comfortable leading end\-to\-end \- from architecture through to the docs page a developer or an agent is reading when they get stuck.

**Requirements**

* 5\+ years building production software (libraries, services, or dev\-tools a plus \- developer platforms or API products especially relevant here).
* Proficiency in Java \& TypeScript. Skills in C\#/.NET, Python \& Go are a bonus.
* Solid grasp of modern API and integration patterns.
* Experience building or maintaining developer\-facing documentation: docs\-as\-code, API reference generation, or interactive examples.
* Comfortable with CI/CD (GitHub Actions and/or Jenkins), git, and code review.
* Experience publishing artifacts and managing repos (Maven, NuGet, PyPI, Nexus/Artifactory).
* Working knowledge of semantic versioning, release notes, and changelog hygiene.
* Basic security hygiene: artifact signing, checksums, SBOM mindset.
* Right to work in the UK; fluent in written and spoken English.

**Desirable Extras**

* Experience designing APIs or tools built for AI agent consumption \- function calling, MCP, tool/schema design.
* Building sandbox environments, mock servers, or contract/conformance testing frameworks.
* Go (concurrency patterns), idiomatic TypeScript design.
* Docs\-as\-code, ADRs, conformance/contract testing.
* Exposure to OAuth/OIDC, mTLS, and PKI basics.
* Cloud \& infra awareness (AWS/Azure/GCP, containers, runners).
* Prior agency/consulting experience and/or regulated industries.

Mott MacDonald Bentley is a fully integrated design and build business combining the design expertise of Mott MacDonald with the contracting experience of JN Bentley to deliver award winning projects. Working for Mott MacDonald Bentley, you will work on major water and wastewater schemes throughout all phases of the project from feasibility through to construction. With an annual turnover surpassing £600 million, Mott Macdonald Bentley cements its position as a leader within the industry. The sustained, robust business performance creates an ideal environment for career growth.

  

As part of our appointment to Scottish Water’s new Enterprise, we will deliver projects at sites across Scotland. Works will include major upgrades to treatment assets, new and enhanced networks, and resilience schemes that will benefit communities across the country.

  

**25\+ years in the water sector**

  

Over successive regulatory periods, MMB has delivered a wide range of complex water and wastewater projects that directly support SR27 priorities, including:

  

* Enhancing resilience and service reliability through treatment works upgrades, network improvements and resilience schemes


* Supporting net zero and climate adaptation via low carbon design, nature based solutions and environmental compliance projects


* Enabling sustainable growth by delivering infrastructure that supports new development and protects existing communities


* Driving efficiency and affordability through integrated delivery, innovation and collaborative planning


* Maintaining a strong focus on customers, communities and safety across everything we do

  

As a Principal Civil Engineer you'll work on projects that make a real difference to our environment and our communities \- enhancing the efficiency and effectiveness of water and wastewater treatment systems.


You will play a pivotal role in shaping the civil functions throughout the lifecycle of various projects. From concept design to commissioning, you will ensure that all civil aspects are meticulously considered and integrated.

  

**The role of a Principal Civil Engineer includes:**

  

* Lead and oversee the design, planning, and execution of civil engineering on projects.


* Providing design support and guidance for schemes and ensuring all designs are fit for purpose and meet current legislation and standards


* Working closely and collaboratively with the commercial, operational and construction teams to develop efficient, practical and safe solutions throughout design stages, construction and beyond


* Positively engage with the client, managing relationships and adopting a one\-team approach to supporting them in achieving their aims


* Managing the interfaces and integration of the civil design with that of other disciplines and production of documentation


* Acting as technical checker on project documents, and undertaking technical reviews for projects across teams


* Identifying opportunities to improve delivery processes including development and implementation of standard designs, sustainable solutions, and digital tools


* Undertaking site reviews to ensure buildability of solutions and integration within the existing systems


* Supporting the development of the civil engineering team, coaching and mentoring engineers to develop their skill set and identifying the correct resource for the projects

  

**What you’ll need:**

  

* Degree in Civil Engineering, or related field


* Chartership (CEng) with a relevant Engineering Institution


* Minimum of 10 years of experience in civil engineering including hydraulic and concrete structure design.


* Proven ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines.


* Experience of successfully delivering high quality outputs in accordance with design, quality and safety standards


* Ability to communicate effectively with team members and stakeholders


* A willingness to travel to sites across your operational region

  

**Preferred skills:**

  

* Experience with sustainable design and green building practices.


* Proficiency in civil engineering software and tools.


* Strong understanding of regulatory requirements and industry standards applicable within the water and wastewater sector


* Experience of temporary works design

  

**What’s in it for you:**

  

Alongside our significant training and development investment and bespoke progression plan, we offer a wide range of financial, lifestyle, health and wellbeing benefits that you can tailor to your needs. At Mott MacDonald Bentley you will be offered a competitive salary which is commensurate based on your experience. Our core benefits include:

  

* Pension matched by employer up to 7%


* Option to purchase, sell and carry over annual leave


* Life assurance / Private Medical Insurance / Critical Illness Insurance and Health Screening options


* 26 weeks maternity leave, enhanced paternity and adoption leave/ Shared parental leave


* Payment of annual professional institution subscription costs


* Gym Membership discounts UK wide


* Cycle to work scheme, interest free season ticket loans and discounted dining cards also available

  

\*\*Mott MacDonald Bentley are not currently offering sponsorship to candidates under the Skilled Worker visa route in the UK. This decision is as a consequence of the changes made to the Skilled Worker route by the UK Government in April 2024\. We continue to welcome applications from candidates who are eligible for alternative immigration routes in the UK, that do not require sponsorship as a Skilled Worker now or in future.\*\*

  

**Other Information**


**About Mott MacDonald**


Mott MacDonald is a global engineering, management and development consultancy.


Our purpose is to improve society by considering social outcomes in everything we do, relentlessly focusing on excellence and digital innovation, transforming our clients’ businesses, our communities and employee opportunities.

  

A fundamental part of this is respecting each person’s differences and striving to meet their needs.


**Our values:** progress, respect, integrity, drive, excellence.

  

**We believe that because we care about what we do, we do things better.**


We know that our people are our most valuable asset, so we are dedicated to investing in them, through our comprehensive training and development schemes, exposure to the wider design and build business and endless opportunities.

  

We are committed to creating a workplace where our people are safe, have a voice, can reach their full potential, and everyone shares in the rewards.


You’ll have the opportunity to contribute to projects that benefit our communities – from helping to secure water supplies for future generations to protecting homes and businesses from flood risk – our projects make a real difference.

  

**Diversity, Equity \& Inclusion**


A Mott MacDonald Bentley we welcome applications from all sectors of the community. We are dedicated to building a diverse workplace where everyone feels included, has the opportunity to thrive, and is treated with respect.

  

Even if you don’t meet every requirement for this role but are excited about the opportunity, we encourage you to apply. Find out more about our approach to Diversity, Equity \& Inclusion here: https://www.mottmacbentley.co.uk/people.

  

We are committed to ensuring that our recruitment practices are barrier\-free and as inclusive as possible. This includes making adjustments during the job application process and throughout your future career with us. Please call 01756 691572 or email recruitment@jnbentley.co.uk to discuss any such adjustments that we can make. You can read more about our Equal Opportunities Policy here: Equality, diversity and inclusion \- Mott MacDonald

  

**Agile working**


We are committed to providing a flexible and agile working environment that supports both our employees and the needs of the business.

Mott MacDonald Bentley is a fully integrated design and build business combining the design expertise of Mott MacDonald with the contracting experience of JN Bentley to deliver award winning projects.

  

With an annual turnover surpassing £600 million, Mott Macdonald Bentley cements its position as a leader within the industry. The sustained, robust business performance creates an ideal environment for career growth.

  

As part of our appointment to Scottish Water’s new Enterprise, we will deliver projects at sites across Scotland. Works will include major upgrades to treatment assets, new and enhanced networks, and resilience schemes that will benefit communities across the country.

  

**25\+ years in the water sector**

  

Over successive regulatory periods, MMB has delivered a wide range of complex water and wastewater projects that directly support SR27 priorities, including:

  

* Enhancing resilience and service reliability through treatment works upgrades, network improvements and resilience schemes
* Supporting net zero and climate adaptation via low carbon design, nature based solutions and environmental compliance projects
* Enabling sustainable growth by delivering infrastructure that supports new development and protects existing communities
* Driving efficiency and affordability through integrated delivery, innovation and collaborative planning
  

Maintaining a strong focus on customers, communities and safety across everything we do
  

  

As a Senior Electrical Engineer you will contribute to projects that significantly impact our environment and communities. Working primarily in the UK water market, MMB provides the feasibility, design, construction, and commissioning services needed to keep water flowing and wastewater treated. You’ll work on projects that make a real difference to our environment and our communities by enhancing the efficiency and effectiveness of water and wastewater treatment systems.  



You will play a pivotal role in shaping the electrical functions throughout the lifecycle of various projects. From concept design to commissioning, you will ensure that all electrical aspects are meticulously considered and integrated.

  

**The role of a Senior Electrical Engineer includes:**

  

* Preparing and reviewing electrical engineering designs for water treatment equipment on our client's site. You will be working with Motor Control Centres, LV distribution systems, Cabling, Instrumentation, Industrial Networks, PLCs and SCADA. Systems will be both new latest technology and existing legacy installations.
* Producing and reviewing technical specifications and schedules for procurement activities, reviewing supplier tender bids and technical submissions.
* Supervising and mentoring our Graduates and Engineers assisting them to develop their knowledge and skills.
* Understanding, applying and contributing to design standards with a good knowledge of Client and WIMES standards.
* Positively engaging with the client, building relationships and supporting them to achieve their aims.
  

**What you’ll need:**

  

* Degree in Electrical Engineering, or related field
* Chartered or incorporated member of professional institution e.g ICE, IMechE, etc, or equivalent experience
* Experience of successfully delivering high quality outputs in accordance with design, quality and safety standards
* Ability to communicate effectively with team members and stakeholders
* Methodical approach to problem solving
* A valid driving licence and willingness to travel to sites across your operational region
  

**What’s in it for you:**

  

**Financial wellbeing**

  

* MMB match employee pension contributions between 4\.5% and 7%.
* As an independently owned business we share the financial success of the business with all our colleagues including our annual bonus schemes.
* Payment of annual professional institution subscription costs
  

**Health and wellbeing**

  

* A minimum of 33 days holiday each year, inclusive of public holidays, with the ability to buy, sell or carry over annual leave through our flexible benefits programme.
* Access to Life Assurance / Private Medical Insurance / Critical Illness Insurance and Health Screening options
* We are happy to talk openly about flexible working and how we can support your responsibilities beyond the workplace.
* Join a wide range of groups including our Advanced Employee Networks which support our LGBTQ\+, gender, race and ethnicity, disability, and parents/carers communities.
* Enhanced family and carers leave
* Enhanced family leave policies, including 26 weeks paid maternity and adoption leave, and two weeks paid paternity/partner leave plus the option for shared parental leave.
* Up to 2 paid additional days leave are provided for those with significant caring responsibilities
  

**Learning and development**

  

MMB are committed to empowering our people to grow professionally and thrive in their careers. We offer structured development schemes that support your journey toward professional chartership. From day one, employees are fast\-tracked towards chartership reviews and benefit from mentorship, hands\-on experience, and tailored training opportunities

  

\*\*Mott MacDonald Bentley are not currently offering sponsorship to candidates under the Skilled Worker visa route in the UK. This decision is as a consequence of the changes made to the Skilled Worker route by the UK Government in April 2024\. We continue to welcome applications from candidates who are eligible for alternative immigration routes in the UK, that do not require sponsorship as a Skilled Worker now or in future.\*\*

  

**Other Information**


**About Mott MacDonald**


Mott MacDonald is a global engineering, management and development consultancy.


Our purpose is to improve society by considering social outcomes in everything we do, relentlessly focusing on excellence and digital innovation, transforming our clients’ businesses, our communities and employee opportunities.

  

A fundamental part of this is respecting each person’s differences and striving to meet their needs.


Our values: progress, respect, integrity, drive, excellence.

  

**We believe that because we care about what we do, we do things better.**


We know that our people are our most valuable asset, so we are dedicated to investing in them, through our comprehensive training and development schemes, exposure to the wider design and build business and endless opportunities.

  

We are committed to creating a workplace where our people are safe, have a voice, can reach their full potential, and everyone shares in the rewards.


You’ll have the opportunity to contribute to projects that benefit our communities – from helping to secure water supplies for future generations to protecting homes and businesses from flood risk – our projects make a real difference.

  

**Diversity, Equity \& Inclusion**


A Mott MacDonald Bentley we welcome applications from all sectors of the community. We are dedicated to building a diverse workplace where everyone feels included, has the opportunity to thrive, and is treated with respect.

  

Even if you don’t meet every requirement for this role but are excited about the opportunity, we encourage you to apply. Find out more about our approach to Diversity, Equity \& Inclusion here: https://www.mottmacbentley.co.uk/people.

  

We are committed to ensuring that our recruitment practices are barrier\-free and as inclusive as possible. This includes making adjustments during the job application process and throughout your future career with us. Please call 01756 691572 or email recruitment@jnbentley.co.uk to discuss any such adjustments that we can make. You can read more about our Equal Opportunities Policy here: Equality, diversity and inclusion \- Mott MacDonald

  

**Agile working**


We are committed to providing a flexible and agile working environment that supports both our employees and the needs of the business.
