jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Do you want to solve real customer problems through innovative technology? Do you enjoy working on scalable services in a collaborative team environment? Do you want to see your code directly impact millions of customers worldwide?
  

  

At Amazon, we hire the best minds in technology to innovate and build on behalf of our customers. Customer obsession is part of our company DNA, which has made us one of the world's most beloved brands.
  

  

Our Software Development Engineer (SDE) interns use modern technology to solve complex problems while seeing their work's impact first\-hand. The challenges SDE interns solve at Amazon are meaningful and influence millions of customers, sellers, and products globally. We seek individuals passionate about creating new products, features, and services while managing ambiguity in an environment where development cycles are measured in weeks, not years.
  

  

At Amazon, we believe in ownership at every level. As an SDE intern, you'll own the entire lifecycle of your code \- from design through deployment and ongoing operations. This ownership mindset, combined with our commitment to operational excellence, ensures we deliver the highest quality solutions for our customers.
  

  

We're looking for curious minds who think big and want to define tomorrow's technology. At Amazon, you'll grow into the high\-impact engineer you know you can be, supported by a culture of learning and mentorship. Every day brings exciting new challenges and opportunities for personal growth.
  

  

Amazon internships across all seasons are full\-time positions, and interns should expect to work in office, Monday\-Friday, up to 40 hours per week typically between 8am\-5pm. Specific team norms around working hours will be communicated by your manager. Interns should not have conflicts such as classes or other employment during the Amazon work\-day. Applicants should have a minimum of one quarter/semester/trimester remaining in their studies after their internship concludes.
  

  

Key job responsibilities  

Collaborate and communicate effectively with experienced cross\-disciplinary Amazonians to design, build, and operate innovative products and services that delight our customers, while participating in technical discussions to drive solutions forward.
  

  

Break down complex, ambiguous problems into well\-defined, solvable components before implementation.
  

  

Contribute to the design and development of scalable, reliable services, with distributed\-systems scope varying by team.
  

  

Participate in code reviews as a core engineering practice, providing constructive feedback and validating correctness.
  

  

Contribute to clear and accurate technical documentation.
  

  

Use GenAI and AI\-powered tools to enhance development productivity, and critically validate, verify, and integrate AI\-generated code, exercising sound judgement about when to trust AI output.
  

  

Write clean, maintainable code following best practices and design patterns.
  

  

Work in an agile environment practicing CI/CD principles while participating in operational responsibilities including on\-call duties.
  

  

Demonstrate operational excellence through monitoring, troubleshooting, and resolving production issues.
  

  

A day in the life  

As an intern, you will be matched to a manager and a mentor and will have the opportunity to influence the evolution of Amazon technology and lead critical projects early in your career.
  

  

In addition to working on an impactful project, you will have the opportunity to engage with Amazonians for both personal and professional development, expand your network, and participate in activities with other interns throughout your internship. No matter the location of your internship, we give you the tools to own your project and learn in a real\-world setting.
  

  

About the team  

Intern Community:
  

  

As an Amazon Intern, you'll be part of a vibrant, supportive community that empowers your growth and development. You'll collaborate with interns from around the world, networking and participating in social events to broaden your perspectives. You can also join specialized groups focused on areas like sustainability to explore your diverse interests.
  

  

Support:
  

  

The internship program provides a robust support system, including weekly intern office hours, dedicated IT and HR support, and a program team committed to your success. This ensures you have the guidance and assistance needed to thrive.
  

  

Learning Sessions:
  

  

Exclusive learning sessions will further enhance your skills, granting you access to Amazon's cutting\-edge learning platforms and the expertise of industry leaders. These structured development opportunities will prepare you for the next step in your career.
  

  

Opportunities:
  

  

Upon successful completion of the internship, you may be considered for a graduate role or a second internship, allowing you to continue your journey with Amazon. Additionally, you'll enjoy a competitive monthly salary, relocation support, and access to a range of employee benefits.


**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Are enrolled in a Bachelor's degree or above in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related fields at time of application
* Knowledge of computer science fundamentals such as object\-oriented design, operating systems, algorithms, data structures, and complexity analysis
* Experience with at least one general\-purpose programming language such as Java, Python, C\+\+, C\#, Go, Rust, or TypeScript

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience from a technical internship
* Experience with distributed, multi\-tiered systems, algorithms, and relational databases
* Experience in optimization mathematics such as linear programming and nonlinear optimization
* Experience with Cloud platforms (preferably AWS), database systems (SQL and NoSQL), AI tools for development productivity, contributing to open\-source projects, and/or version control systems
* Experience using AI\-assisted development tools in academic or professional settings
* Ability to effectively articulate technical challenges and solutions
* Adept at handling ambiguous or undefined problems as well as ability to think abstractly
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills

  

Amazon is an equal opportunities employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build. Protecting your privacy and the security of your data is a longstanding top priority for Amazon. Please consult our Privacy Notice (https://www.amazon.jobs/en/privacy\_page) to know more about how we collect, use and transfer the personal data of our candidates.  

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.  

The minimum gross base pay salary for this position is listed below. The base salary listed corresponds to working on a full\-time basis. For part\-time hours, the salary will be pro\-rated.


Company supplementary benefits apply subject to further terms, including pension plans, health insurance, life and disability insurance, business travel insurance, MultiSport card, employee discount code and program (EDC/Extras), and the Employee Assistance Program (private and confidential counselling and referral service to support health and well\-being).

At Electrolux Group, a leading global appliance company, we strive every day to shape living for the better for our consumers, our people and our planet. We share ideas and collaborate so that together, we can develop solutions that deliver enjoyable and sustainable living.

jobs.title: Senior Product Engineer
jobs.description:
**Product Engineer – AI\-drivet produktteam**

**Om rollen**


Vi söker en Product Engineer till ett produktteam som arbetar enligt ett AI\-assisterat arbetssätt, där stora delar av koden genereras med hjälp av AI\-verktyg.


I takt med att själva implementationsarbetet gått snabbare har fokus flyttats mot att formulera rätt krav, förstå domänen på djupet, bygga tydlig kontext och ge AI:n rätt förutsättningar för att leverera väl fungerande lösningar. I den här rollen blir du en nyckelperson i det arbetet.


Du förenar teknisk kompetens med produkt\- och kravarbete och driver frågor hela vägen från idé till färdig lösning – genom att ställa rätt frågor, strukturera och förbereda underlag, bygga relevant kontext för AI\-verktygen och säkerställa att kraven är tillräckligt tydliga för att omsättas i fungerande kod.


Du behåller samtidigt din tekniska hands\-on\-förmåga och bidrar vid behov med implementation, kodgranskning och testning av AI\-genererad kod. Fördelningen mellan kravarbete och utveckling varierar från uppgift till uppgift.


Rollen passar dig som trivs i skärningspunkten mellan produkt och teknik och som drivs av att vara med och forma nya arbetssätt där AI är en naturlig del av utvecklingsprocessen. Du samarbetar tätt med produkt, arkitektur och utveckling, och får ett brett ansvar för att driva arbetet framåt – från identifierat behov till levererad funktionalitet.


Arbetet bedrivs i mindre, fokuserade team där du som Product Engineer har en central funktion i att samordna krav, skapa goda förutsättningar för utvecklingsarbetet och säkerställa att lösningen hänger ihop både funktionellt och tekniskt.

**Teknisk miljö**

* Backend: .NET Core
* Frontend: React
* Drift: Microsoft Azure
* Databas: MongoDB (Atlas)
* Miljön är ISO 27001\-certifierad och utvecklas enligt organisationens interna säkerhetsramverk och riktlinjer

**Kvalifikationer**

* Mycket god erfarenhet av Claude eller motsvarande AI\-baserade kodningsverktyg, och en stark förmåga att omsätta domänproblem och krav till tydliga, väl underbyggda prompter som leder till rätt tekniskt resultat
* Gedigen teknisk kompetens och förmåga att själv koda för att granska, felsöka och vid behov skriva eller justera kod
* Förmåga att arbeta nära produktsidan, ställa rätt frågor, strukturera underlag och driva krav framåt utan att invänta färdiga specifikationer

**Meriterande**

* Erfarenhet av GDPR/dataskydd och/eller informationssäkerhet är meriterande, eftersom produkten verkar inom detta område och sådan kunskap stärker förmågan att formulera relevanta och välgrundade krav

jobs.title: Senior .NET-utvecklare
jobs.description:
Är du en erfaren .NET\-utvecklare som gillar modern teknik, smarta kollegor och uppdrag där du faktiskt får påverka? Då vill vi gärna prata med dig.
  
Just nu söker vi flera .NET\-utvecklare till våra kommande konsultuppdrag i Stockholm. Skicka gärna in en ansökan om du är på jakt efter ett nytt spännande uppdrag eller bara nyfiken på vad marknaden har att erbjuda, så kikar vi om vi har något inne som kan passa.
  
Om Devoote
  
På Devoote tror vi på nära relationer, tekniskt intressanta uppdrag och en vardag där konsulterna faktiskt känner varandra. Hos oss handlar det inte bara om nästa uppdrag, utan om att bygga långsiktiga relationer med både kunder och konsulter.
  
Oavsett om du är anställd eller underkonsult blir du en del av vårt nätverk med erfarenhetsutbyten, tekniksnack, AW: s, middagar och aktiviteter som vi gör för att det är roligt!
  
Om rollen
  
Som konsult hos Devoote kommer du att arbeta i uppdrag hos våra kunder i Stockholm. Uppdragens innehåll varierar beroende på kund, team och bransch, men du kommer vanligtvis att arbeta med utveckling av moderna affärskritiska system och digitala tjänster.
  
Beroende på uppdrag kan du vara involverad i hela utvecklingsprocessen, från design och arkitektur till implementation, testning och drift. Du kan också komma att arbeta nära utvecklare, arkitekter, produktägare och andra intressenter i agila team där kvalitet, innovation och kunskapsdelning står i fokus.
  
Vi arbetar med längre uppdrag hos välkända företag och strävar efter att hitta uppdrag som matchar din kompetens, erfarenhet och dina karriärmål.
  
Vi söker dig som har
  
Minst 5 års erfarenhet av systemutveckling i .NET
  
Goda kunskaper i .NET och C\#
  
Erfarenhet av React och TypeScript
  
Erfarenhet av Azure
  
Flytande svenska och engelska i tal och skrift
  
  

Personliga egenskaper
  
  

**Vi tror att du:**  

Är lösningsorienterad och nyfiken
  
Tar eget ansvar och driver ditt arbete framåt
  
Trivs med samarbete och kunskapsdelning
  
  

Därför väljer utvecklare Devoote
  
Hos oss får du mer än bara ett nytt uppdrag.
  
Långa uppdrag där du får möjlighet att skapa verkligt värde över tid
  
Frihet att påverka hur du arbetar och vilka lösningar du driver fram
  
Snabba beslut och korta vägar mellan idé och genomförande
  
Möjlighet att arbeta hos några av Sveriges mest välkända företag
  
Regelbundna middagar, aktiviteter och event för den som vill vara med
  
  

Låter det intressant?
  
Oavsett om du är nyfiken på att bli anställd konsult eller driver eget är du varmt välkommen att höra av dig.
  
Vi ser fram emot att lära känna dig!

SEB is more than just a bank with an IT function. We are a tech company powered by innovation and fueled by collaboration. From COBOL to AI and everything in between, we offer you an impressive tech stack and several technology paths. Together we're innovating and building the tech arena of the future. Are you ready to take on a new challenge? If so, you'll be interested in this opportunity!


**About the role:**



Join the IRS team and help drive one of SEB's strategic account and interest rate services. We are looking for a senior developer who enjoys taking ownership from design and development all the way to production support and operational excellence.



This role is ideal for a senior engineer who wants significant responsibility, technical influence, and direct impact on a business\-critical platform.



As a senior C\# developer, you will play a key role in driving the development and implementation of SEB’s account administration and interest rate services team. You will onboard to a recently developed Interest Rate Service solution with an exciting roadmap that serves as a strategic enabler within the Accounts offering, built in\-house on a standardized technology stack using .NET and Angular. Working as part of an agile team of skilled developers, you will contribute hands\-on to designing, developing, and delivering high\-quality software, while collaborating closely with product owners and stakeholders to define and ship new features. You will work with technologies such as C\#/.NET, PostgreSQL, OpenShift, GitHub Actions, and Angular, participate in technical, architectural, and methodological investigations, and help ensure performance, quality, responsiveness, code quality, organization, and automation across the solution.


**What you'll do**


* Build and evolve business\-critical APIs and services using .NET
* Design robust solutions and drive technical improvements
* Work hands\-on with PostgreSQL, Entity Framework Core, OpenShift, GitHub Actions, and Angular
* Take ownership of production stability, incident resolution, and operational excellence
* Collaborate closely with product owners, architects, and stakeholders to deliver customer value

* Are a senior developer with strong C\#/.NET and SQL skills
* Has strong experience with OpenShift and CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, deployment automation, and DevOps practices
* Enjoy taking ownership and solving complex problems independently

* Care about code quality, automation, maintainability, and reliability

**Do you want to be part of SEB?**  

  

It is our fundamental belief that inclusion and diversity is crucial for our future success. We strive to have an inclusive, value\-driven culture where employees feel valued, respected, and involved irrespective of who they are, what they believe or where they come from.



We encourage you to submit your application no later than 28th of September via the link in this advertisement. If you have any questions about the position, please contact Hiring Manager Jia Linder at jia.linder@seb.se. Kindly note that we do not accept applications via email.

jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer (C#/.Net) (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
**Company Description**  

Everyone’s story matters. Come shape your story with us at Riverty.  

**But where does that take you?**


To one of our 30 hybrid workspaces – designed for exchanging ideas, learning from others, and shaping the way we work. An international community of over 4,000 people, representing almost 80 nationalities across 11 countries. United by one mission: Combining empathy, advanced technology and data\-driven insights to keep people and businesses in flow. With payments made for them. So that they don’t have to worry about it.

**And there’s more.** We are part of the family\-owned Bertelsmann group. Established. Corporate. In a fast\-paced industry. We enable flexible payments in various industries, simplifying the financial management of known brands and helping people repay debt to build financial confidence. In short: shaping FinTech.

 **Job Description** **We are looking for a**

**Senior Backend Engineer (C\#/.Net) (m/f/d)**

**Join our team at our location in Stockholm – hybrid working conditions available.**

  

Our solutions contribute to flexible and customer\-friendly payment alternatives. We offer consumers the opportunity to choose when and how they want to pay, whilst guaranteeing a steady and predictable cashflow for merchants. Our products make us proud, but not content and we have high ambitions for our existing as well as upcoming products. We have a strong commitment to building the future of FinTech — human\-centric and sustainable. With investments to back it up. You will be part of a new and quickly growing product \& tech organisation, having the opportunity to shape our new teams as well as build the next revolutionary products.

 **What you’ll actually be doing**


As part of a cross\-functional product team, you’ll take meaningful ownership across the full software lifecycle:

* **Build \& scale core services:** Design, build, and ship robust backend services, APIs, and business\-critical workflows using modern C\# and .NET.
* **Shape system architecture:** Drive decisions on scalability, resilience, and performance for high\-throughput distributed systems.
* **Turn requirements into reality:** Partner with product managers, designers, and domain experts to translate complex business needs into pragmatic technical solutions.
* **Elevate the team:** Mentor colleagues, conduct thoughtful code reviews, and share knowledge to help the engineering group grow.
* **Own production health:** Champion automated testing, clean documentation, and reliable deployment practices so we ship with confidence.

 **Qualifications** **Who you are:**


You’re an experienced engineer who enjoys untangling complex problems and balances engineering excellence with pragmatic delivery:

* **Backend depth:** 8\+ years of hands\-on software engineering experience, with deep expertise in **C\# and modern .NET**.
* **Distributed systems:** Practical experience designing clean REST APIs, message queues, event\-driven workflows, and asynchronous communication patterns.
* **Data fluency:** Strong background with relational databases (e.g., SQL Server, PostgreSQL), query optimization, and ORMs like EF Core or Dapper.
* **Cloud \& DevOps:** Experience deploying and managing containerized services (Docker/Kubernetes) in cloud environments, ideally Microsoft Azure.
* **Observability \& troubleshooting:** Skilled at diagnosing and resolving complex production issues using logs, metrics, and distributed tracing.
* **Pragmatic tooling:** Comfortable leveraging AI coding assistants (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor) to move faster, while applying sharp judgment to ensure security and code quality.
* **Clear communication:** Fluent in English, with the ability to explain technical trade\-offs to both engineering peers and non\-technical partners.
* **Bonus points:** Prior experience with FinTech, banking, payments, or ledger/accounting systems is a strong plus.

 **Please note:** you need to have EU citizenship or a valid work permit for Sweden.

 **Additional Information** **Disclosure requirements pertaining to the collection of your personal data:**

  

Responsible for processing the information provided in your application is the company specified in the job advertisement, with its registered office as indicated. The company processes your data for the purpose of establishing an employment relationship on the basis of Art. 6 (1\) b GDPR / Section 26 (1\) sentence 1 BDSG.

### **Uppdragsbeskrivning**


Vi söker en senior fullstackutvecklare med stark DevOps\-profil som kan ta ett helhetsansvar genom hela utvecklingskedjan. Rollen kombinerar mjukvaruutveckling med teknisk styrning, integrationsarbete, miljöhantering och driftsättning.


Du kommer att bidra till utvecklingen av moderna webbapplikationer och kringliggande tjänster som tillsammans utgör en ny digital förmåga inom verksamheten. Uppdraget innebär nära samarbete med flera utvecklingsteam och verksamhetsintressenter, där du förväntas kunna omsätta verksamhetsbehov till hållbara tekniska lösningar.

* Utveckla och vidareutveckla webbapplikationer med tyngdpunkt på React/TypeScript och .NET/C\#.
* Ansvara för teknisk konfiguration och förvaltning av on\-premise\-miljöer samt containerbaserade plattformar.

Join either **Data Discovery \& Experience** or **API Platform** , two teams within API \& Data Products Solutions.

**About the role**

You will help shape AI\-powered experiences by enabling AI agents, APIs, MCPs, and Data Products to create value for developers, employees, partners, and customers.

  

  

Working hands\-on with modern AI technologies, agent frameworks, APIs, and platform capabilities, you will build scalable solutions that enable teams across If to discover, access, and use digital capabilities more effectively.

* Help ensure secure access using open standards.

**We offer**

In the same way that we place high demands on you as an employee, we also expect you to place high demands on us as an employer. Here are some of the benefits of working at If:

  

  

* An including work environment where everyone is welcome
* Career and development opportunities in the biggest insurance company in the Nordics
* Social activities, as well as highly skilled professional environment
* Possibility of hybrid workplace

* Great insurance benefits

The **Data Discovery \& Experience** team works closely with business and technical stakeholders to improve how APIs and Data are discovered, understood, and used as Products across If.

  

  

The **API Platform** team focuses on building and evolving common platform capabilities that enable secure, scalable, and efficient API consumption and integration across If and with external partners.


Both teams use agile ways of working and collaborate closely with stakeholders across business and technology domains.

  

  

This position is also a part of a larger agile Tribe responsible for providing common API and IAM capabilities that enable If's business to grow in a secure, scalable, and compliant manner. We support both internal teams and external partners through technology, products, processes, training, and governance.

  

  

**Who are you?**

You are curious, innovative, and motivated by making hard things look easy.

  

  

You enjoy experimenting with new technologies and turning ideas into working solutions. You combine strong technical skills with a product mindset and are excited about creating experiences that are useful, intuitive, and valuable to users.

  

  

You are comfortable navigating uncertainty, learning quickly, and working in a field that is evolving.

  

  

You see AI not as a standalone technology, but as a capability that becomes powerful when combined with data, business processes, and great user experiences.

  

  

You are passionate about agile ways of working, continuous improvement, and exploring new technologies.

  

  

You have the ability to make complex technical concepts understandable and actionable for both technical and business stakeholders.  

  



You also have:

Experience from one or more of the following areas is considered a strong advantage:

**Work location:** Bergshamra, Stockholm

For more information, please contact Daniel Sahlin, Head of API and Data Product Solutions, \+46 (0\) 771 43 00 00

  

  

Final candidates will undergo a background check before employment.

  

  

We look forward to your application!

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (Data Ingestion Platform)
jobs.description:
**Who we are**


4C Strategies builds organisational readiness and military training management software for clients in over 70 countries. Our flagship product, Exonaut, is used by NATO and allied forces to plan, run and evaluate exercises in real time. Our consultants and engineers work alongside armed forces across the UK, Europe, North America and beyond to deliver training and exercise management solutions.

**What we're building**


We're building the data ingestion platform behind large\-scale training exercises: a service that takes traffic from simulation federations, unmanned\-system sensor networks and real\-world sensor feeds, and turns it into one coherent stream that subscribing systems can act on. The bet is that these streams should be interpreted and mapped to an internal Ontology rather than re\-interpreted by every product that needs it. So the hard part is as much modelling as engineering — deciding what those bytes actually mean, and then holding that meaning stable as the number of sources and consumers grows. The platform is greenfield, and you'll have real influence over its shape.

**How we build**


Modern Java. The principles are conservative on purpose: boring technology, simplicity over cleverness, in\-process over distributed, shared\-nothing over shared state, domain wrapped by ports and adapters. Redundancy is an architectural property, not an operational afterthought. Designs are argued from the problem, not from what a framework happens to make easy. Proposals go through RFCs; decisions are recorded in ADRs.


Two constraints shape most of what we do. Everything the platform produces must be traceable back to the raw feed and the exact configuration that produced it — a customer has to be able to replay an exercise and defend the result. And it has to run where exercises actually run: constrained hardware, intermittent connectivity, air\-gapped sites, limited patch windows, secure by design and observability good enough for an operator in the field with no one to call.

**You**


Substantial engineering experience, opinionated about design, and comfortable arguing a position in writing. Sound judgement on reliability, security, performance, operations and cost is mandatory. Familiarity with simulation or sensor standards, IoT, geospatial mathematics or high\-throughput ingestion is a real advantage — the domain is learnable, the principles less so. We'd also rather hear about how you simplified a distributed system rather than the one you built using multiple services.


The engineering team is small, but what we are building sits at the centre of the portfolio and draws the people who know this domain best — some of the strongest simulation and modelling expertise anywhere in the field is in this building, and closely engaged in what we're building. The bar is high. Your designs will be challenged, and you'll be expected to challenge back — including on scope, since most of the pressure on a platform like this comes as reasonable\-sounding requests for one more special case.


Research shows some people only apply when they meet every requirement. If you don't tick every box but recognise yourself in much of the above, please apply anyway. We'd genuinely like to hear from you.

**Security and citizenship**


This role supports defence work, so the successful candidate must hold Swedish citizenship and pass Swedish security vetting (säkerhetsprövning). We will explain what the check involves early in the process rather than late — a requirement like this should never be a surprise at offer stage.


This requirement comes only from the security rules that govern defence work, not from personal preference.

**Why it matters**


Deterrence works only when a capability is real, and a capability is only real once it has been trained and tested under conditions close to the ones it would face. This is about making sure the organisations that would hold the line are ready.

**How we hire**


Every interview has a written script and a scored rubric, applied the same way to every candidate.

* **Hiring Manager Screen** — a conversation about your experience, how you work and what


you want next.

* **System Design** — a design discussion drawn from problems like the ones above.
* **Programming** — a hands\-on session in a language of your choice (Java, C\#, TypeScript, Python or Go).
* **Culture Interview** — how you collaborate, disagree and make decisions with others.
* **Candidate Q\&A** — your time to interrogate us. We expect you to use it.


We then debrief as a panel and decide. We review applications on a rolling basis.

**What you can expect from 4C Strategies**

* Stockholm\-based, with hybrid working.
* Competitive salary, reviewed annually.
* Occupational pension (tjänstepension).
* Wellness allowance (friskvårdsbidrag).
* Healthcare insurance, including insurance for treatment.
* Parental pay.
* Vaccinations.
* A supportive, collaborative team building meaningful products for mission\-critical work.

**Why Join 4C Strategies**


If you're happiest when the path isn't drawn yet, this is a rare chance to own hard, open problems on a large, multi\-year programme — real scale, real production systems, and the freedom to shape how they're built — with a collaborative team to figure the hard parts out alongside you. You'll work alongside experienced engineers and military specialists, with the individual\-contributor track valued as highly as management, so you can grow without leaving the code behind.


The work matters: what you build helps armed forces, public safety and resilience organisations train, prepare, and respond. If you want senior\-level ownership on systems that are used in earnest — not a backlog ticket factory — this is that role.

**How to apply**


To apply, click the Apply today button and submit your CV. A short cover note on your experience and motivation is welcome but not required. We review applications on a rolling basis, so please apply as soon as you can.


4C Strategies is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Job Summary  


NetApp's Azure NetApp Files (ANF) team is building industry\-leading cloud storage services that power mission\-critical enterprise workloads in Microsoft Azure. We are looking for a highly motivated software engineer to help develop and operate cloud\-scale distributed systems that span storage, networking, cloud infrastructure, and user experience. This is a unified engineering role where engineers are expected to contribute across development, automated validation, operational readiness, and service reliability. The ideal candidate enjoys solving complex technical challenges, takes ownership from design through production, and thrives in a collaborative, fast\-paced environment.  


Responsibilities  
Own features through the entire software lifecycle including design, implementation, testing, deployment, monitoring, and production support.  
Design, develop, and operate cloud\-native services leveraging containers, microservices, distributed systems principles, and modern CI/CD practices.  
Drive engineering excellence through automated testing, code reviews, operational readiness, and continuous improvement initiatives.

Work closely with product management, architects, and partner teams to translate customer and business requirements into high\-quality technical solutions.

Effectively communicate technical concepts, design tradeoffs, and project status to stakeholders across the organization.  
Contribute to the technical growth of the team through knowledge sharing, code reviews, design discussions, and mentorship opportunities.

12\+ years of experience.  
Strong production software development experience in Go, including development of scalable, secure, production\-quality backend services.  
Experience with Python for test automation, validation frameworks, tooling, CI/CD integration, or operational automation.  
Familiarity with React, TypeScript, C\# is desirable for engineers to work across existing service components and user\-facing workflows.  
Experience developing RESTful APIs and service\-to\-service integrations.  
Experience designing, deploying, and operating microservices\-based applications using Kubernetes, containers, and modern CI/CD practices.  
Experience with software quality practices including automated testing, performance optimization, and security best practices.  
Experience with observability, monitoring, telemetry, and operational excellence practices.  
Experience building and operating cloud\-native distributed systems in Azure.  
Experience in one or more of the following domains: cloud storage services, distributed systems, file systems, databases, data protection, or infrastructure services.  
Strong aptitude for learning new technologies.  
Possess excellent written and verbal communication skills.  
Creative and analytical approach to problem solving.  
Education

Fast stilling Heltid Kristiansand S
* Søknadsfrist **Snarest**
* Mulighet for hjemmekontor **Delvis hjemmekontor**
* Arbeidsspråk **Engelsk, Norsk**
* Sektor **Privat**

  
**Vil du utvikle programvaren som får avanserte roboter og boreutstyr til å fungere sikkert, presist og autonomt?**
===================================================================================================================


**Om stillingen**


Maskin Control utvikler software og kontrollsystemer for boreutstyr, robotiserte løsninger og automatiserte prosesser. Vi kombinerer industriell automasjon, robotteknologi og softwareutvikling for å løse krevende oppgaver i operasjoner der sikkerhet, tilgjengelighet og presisjon er avgjørende.


Vi søker nå en erfaren robotprogrammerer som vil bidra i utviklingen av neste generasjon kontrollsystemer. Du blir en sentral del av et tverrfaglig miljø og får ansvar for å utvikle, integrere, teste og sette i drift robotløsninger som inngår i komplette maskin\- og automasjonssystemer.


Stillingen passer for deg som liker å gå fra problemforståelse og systemdesign til fungerende løsning på virkelig utstyr. Du trives med å feilsøke i komplekse systemer, samarbeide tett med andre fagmiljøer og ta eierskap til leveranser fra idé til idriftsettelse.


**Arbeidsoppgaver**


* Programmering og konfigurering av industrielle roboter og robotceller
* Utvikling av sekvenser, bevegelseslogikk, baner, griperfunksjoner og sikker oppførsel
* Integrasjon mellom robot, PLS, drivsystemer, sensorer, HMI og øvrige kontrollsystemer
* Design, implementasjon og videreutvikling av kontrollarkitektur for automatiserte maskiner
* Testing og verifisering i simulator, testoppsett og på fysisk utstyr
* FAT, idriftsettelse, feilsøking og teknisk støtte i prosjekt\- og leveransefasen
* Bidra til standardisering, gjenbrukbare løsninger og gode utviklingsmetoder
* Utarbeidelse og vedlikehold av teknisk dokumentasjon

**Vi ser etter deg som har**


* Flere års erfaring med programmering og idriftsettelse av industrielle roboter
* Relevant høyere utdanning innen **robotikk, automasjon, kybernetikk, mekatronikk, software** eller tilsvarende praktisk erfaring
* God forståelse av robotceller, koordinatsystemer, bevegelsesplanlegging og samspill mellom robot og maskin
* Erfaring med feilsøking i sammensatte kontrollsystemer og evne til å se helheten fra software til mekanikk og elektro
* Evne til å arbeide strukturert og selvstendig, samtidig som du deler kunnskap og samarbeider godt i team
* Gode norsk\- og engelskkunnskaper, både muntlig og skriftlig

**Det er en fordel om du har erfaring med**


* En eller flere robotplattformer, for eksempel ABB, KUKA, FANUC, Yaskawa eller tilsvarende
* Robotprogrammering, offline\-programmering og simulering
* PLS\-programmering, særlig Siemens TIA Portal.
* Kommunikasjonsprotokoller og integrasjon, som OPC UA, Profinet, eller TCP/IP
* C\#, C\+\+, Python eller andre relevante programmeringsspråk
* Maskinsikkerhet, risikovurdering og standarder for industrielle robot\- og automasjonssystemer
* Erfaring fra drilling, offshore, tungt utstyr eller andre krevende industrielle miljøer

**Hvorfor NOV?**


Hos NOV blir du en del av et sterkt fagmiljø som utvikler teknologi for krevende operasjoner over hele verden. I Maskin Control arbeider vi tett på både utstyret og kundens behov, og du får påvirke hvordan fremtidens automatiserte bore\- og robotsystemer skal bygges.


Du får:

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**Location:** Helsinki, Finland (Hybrid)

**Department:** Software development

**Type:** Full\-time

**Application deadline:** October 13, 2026

 **Are you ready to build the software that helps medical professionals harness the power of AI? Aiforia is transforming the world of tissue diagnostics and medical image analysis. We equip pathologists and scientists with deep learning AI to improve efficiency and consistency across clinical histopathology of cancer.**

**Our mission is to provide high\-quality, AI\-assisted solutions that enable personalized and democratized care for patients. To help us achieve this, we are looking for a driven Software Engineer to build and improve the products that bring our AI to clinical and research users.**

### **Role and responsibilities**


As a core member of our engineering team, you will work across the full stack, from back\-end services to the web applications our customers use every day. You will help expand Aiforia's platform and keep our existing products robust and reliable.

**Your key tasks will include:**

* Architecture and design: Design scalable, robust solutions across the stack, from back\-end services and APIs to user\-facing web features.
* Software implementation: Develop, write, and optimize production\-level code across the stack.
* AI tooling and context: Write and maintain the specifications, repository context, and prompts that make AI workflows possible.
* Quality assurance: Ensure high standards of code quality and reliability through code reviews, unit tests, and validation protocols.
* Technical documentation: Write and maintain clear, accurate technical documentation to support development, regulatory compliance, and cross\-team collaboration.
* Product maintenance: Monitor, troubleshoot, and maintain existing products to ensure seamless performance for our users in clinical and research settings.

### **Who we are looking for**

The ideal candidate is a versatila engineer who is comfortable moving between back\-end front\-end work. You write clean dove, care about the end user, and thrive in a collaborative, mission\-driven environment.
  

  

**Requirements:**

* Educational background: BSc or MSc in Computer Science, Engineering, or a closely related field.
* Experience: 3\+ years of relevant industry experience in full\-stack or software engineering.
* Technical skills: Strong programming skills and hands\-on experience building and deploying web applications and back\-end services in production.
* Communication: Excellent teamwork and communication skills. Fluency in written and spoken English is a must.
* AI\-assisted development: Daily hands\-on use of AI coding tools in production work. You can explain the role of agents and context in the development workflow, and how you verify the result.

**What gives you an edge:**

* Experience and knowledge of image analysis and AI model building, and the workflows associated with them, including data management, verification metrics, and validation.
* Experience building and evolving an AI harness: the infrastructure around the development process that lets agents operate as independent actors across the delivery lifecycle.
* Experience improving how a team adopts AI coding tools: shared context, execution loops, and safety boundaries.
* Experience with our core stack: C\#/.NET.
* Experience with modern front\-end frameworks (e.g. React, Angular, TypeScript).
* Familiarity with REST APIs, databases, and cloud computing platforms.
* Experience with CI/CD, automated testing, and DevOps practices.
* Previous experience working with medical devices, healthcare data, or within regulated environments (e.g. ISO 13485, FDA).

### **What we offer**

* Innovation: A chance to work at the forefront of medical AI technologies and make a real impact on patient care.
* Culture: Join a supportive, enthusiastic, and multidisciplinary team of experts who are passionate about what they do.
* Growth: Real opportunities for professional and career development in one of the fastest\-growing sectors of health tech.

### **Location**


Helsinki, Finland.


We offer a hybrid work model that provides flexibility for your daily life. However, we hope that you will work primarily from our office during the initial stage of your employment. This ensures you receive the best possible support, a smooth onboarding experience, and the opportunity to truly get to know your team from day one.


Please note: We are unable to sponsor visas for this position.

### **How to apply**


Are you the person we are looking for? Please, send your application by October 13, 2026 through careers.aiforia.com.

* For data privacy reasons, we only accept applications submitted via the portal.
* Please include a portfolio or work samples showcasing your design process and past projects.
* Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis prior to the deadline, so please submit yours as soon as possible.


Before you apply: Please read Aiforia's Privacy Policy for Job Applicants before submitting your application.


Aiforia is committed to creating an environment of inclusivity in which all voices and individuals are heard. We strive toward this by providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, citizenship status, age, national origin, ancestry, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected status and to affirmatively seek to advance the principles of equal employment opportunity.

**Aiforia Create:** **https://www.aiforia.com/aiforia\-create**

* Full\-time
* Application and Product Development
* Hybrid
* Tieto Caretech

  
Job Description **At Tieto Caretech you’ll get a chance to provide patients and end users with product offerings that help them in their life, reinventing the world for good. If that sounds interesting, please keep on reading.**

**About us**


Tieto Caretech is modernizing the Nordic health and social care sector with modular, open, and interoperable software. We develop and deliver high quality software solutions and services that enable healthcare and welfare professionals to do their work even better and with higher efficiency \- have more time to care.


We are a global team of professionals working on providing products and services to different sectors from intensive care to laboratory and social care. In addition to working closely with our customers, we also have our own products that we build and develop for various fields in society. From enabling healthcare professionals to spend more valuable time with their patients to providing data for professional athletes to achieve even better results, we make all that possible. With us you can build technology for the good of society and make your mark on the health and wellbeing of people in need.

  

**About the role**


We are now looking for **a Release Train Architect (RTA)** to work with **Tieto Caretech** healthcare products where you will contribute to simplifying everyday life for patients, professionals and customers. In the architect role you will be ensuring that the architectural and technical decisions taken are aligned with Lifecare strategy, data security and set of requirements.

 **In this role you will**

* Design, implement, and verify software architecture with a focus on the bigger picture and product architecture.
* Utilize advanced .NET concepts, design patterns, and SOLID design principles to develop robust software solutions.
* Lead and mentor teams in web development using WebApi, Angular, HTML5, JavaScript, TypeScript, SPA, and NgRx/Redux.
* Apply hands\-on experience in the .Net Stack and other frameworks to deliver full\-stack solutions.
* Implement SOA, IOC, REST API, Microservices, and Event\-driven architecture.

 **We are looking for someone with**

* 10\+ years of experience in the software industry.
* Proficiency in **both** **English** and **Finnish** languages.

Extensive knowledge of web technologies and patterns.  
* 

**It would be beneficial if you also have**

* Experience with cloud development and deployment, preferably in Azure.
* Understanding of Domain Driven Development and Test\-Driven Development.
* Familiarity with C\#, Angular, C\+\+, RabbitMQ, XML, WCF, WPF, IIS/Windows services, SOAP.
* Knowledge of DevOps, Continuous Integration, and Continuous Deployment.
* Awareness of cross\-browser compatibility and web standards.
* Understanding of OpenEHR.
* Experience in the healthcare domain.
* Familiarity with integration standards like FHIR, HL7\.

  

As a person we believe you are a team player who takes action and demonstrate responsibility to organize your work and solve your tasks. With our agile end to end development process you will continuously both learn from and coach your colleagues, so communication is important for us. Technology is developing fast, so learning new cutting\-edge technologies is something you strive to do.

  

**AI knowledge requirement**


AI literacy is expected for this role. You will be comfortable using approved AI tools to improve quality and productivity in everyday work (e.g., drafting, summarising, analysing, and automating routine tasks). You can write clear prompts/instructions, critically evaluate and validate AI outputs, and apply sound judgement when results are incomplete, biased, or incorrect. You understand and follow company policies and applicable legal/regulatory requirements for confidentiality, privacy, security, and responsible AI use (including not sharing sensitive data in unapproved tools).

 **What’s in it for you?**


With us you will be part of the important and meaningful work of developing healthcare for all of us. You have an important mission to make a difference that really matters. In addition, as a company we offer you professional growth, open and friendly culture, and an outstanding work\-life balance! We believe that our organizational culture is an important part of enabling you to be successful. We provide a flexible hybrid work model as part of our culture and way of working.


Finally, we also believe in curiosity and learning as a lifestyle. We want to encourage you to keep up that curiosity and deepen your knowledge on topics you’re interested in. For example, we host an annual ‘Keep Learning Week’, a week where everyone at Tieto has the possibility to join different training courses in a truly global setting.

  

**Could you be our new colleague?**  

  

We look forward to hearing from you! We will fill the position as soon as we find the right person, so we encourage you to apply today. If you have any questions regarding this role, please contact the hiring manager Teijo Mustonen \[teijo.mustonen@tieto.com]

  

Additional Information  

At Tieto, we believe in the power of diversity, equity, and inclusion. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds, genders (m/f/d), and walks of life to join our team, as we believe that this fosters an inspiring workplace and fuels innovation. Our commitment to openness, trust, and diversity is at the heart of our mission to create digital futures that benefit businesses, societies, and humanity.

jobs.title: Senior Software Developer – Embedded & Application
jobs.description:
Our mission is to Profoundly change the standard of care by creating a tomorrow where clinicians can confidently ablate tissue with precision; a tomorrow where patients have access to safe and effective treatment options, so they can quickly return to their daily lives. Changing the standard of care is part of our fabric. We are a group of energetic, problem\-solvers focused on innovation, and looking to change the world. We are changing the paradigm for treating diseases such as prostate cancer by using real\-time MR Imaging, thermal ultrasound and close\-loop temperature feedback control, to gently ablate the diseased tissue with minimal side effects.  



  

If you share our values and want to work in a collaborative results focused culture and want to make a Profound impact in healthcare and your career, here is your chance.

jobs.title: People and Project Manager - for AI-assisted diagnostic medical software
jobs.description:
In 3Shape we work to improve treatment and diagnostics for dental patients by providing innovative scanners and advanced software, tied together in collaborative workflows for the global community of dental professionals worldwide. We are using AI and machine learning methods for analyzing large amounts of medical (dentistry) data – pushing a field which traditionally has looked at 2D images towards 3D scan data.

**The product**


TRIOS Dx offers AI\-assisted dental diagnostic aid tools for monitoring oral health conditions and assessing changes in teeth and gingiva. By analyzing a 3D scan TRIOS Dx assists in diagnosing Caries, Tooth Wear, Gingival recession, and Plaque.


TRIOS Dx was made public and available to end users last year. We are now in a phase where we listen to market feedback and improve the product. We also plan to add new and existing functionality to it over the next many years.

**The position**


We are looking for a skilled People \& Project Manager for the AI team currently responsible for the AI’s diagnosing Caries, Tooth Wear, Gingival recession, and Plaque. You will be driving end\-to\-end delivery of innovative AI solutions and will during this play a key role in ensuring we use state\-of\-the\-art AI solutions, have the right data for AI development, and have thorough and efficient documentation required to get AP approved for use in a Medical Device software. Your main tasks include:

* Build, coach, and develop the team, cultivating an environment where people can do the best work of their lives.
* Lead your team through the full product lifecycle \- from ideation and development to deployment, monitoring, and iteration based on customer feedback.
* Ensure the team have clear ownership of domains, responsibilities, and deliverables.


You will be collaborating with various professionals such as application developers, AI developers, QA, RA, Product Management, and a Clinical Research team of dental professionals.

**Your profile**


We are looking for candidates with a good understanding of the AI and AI development. You may have experience from related positions, and you have a relevant education.

* Master’s degree or a PhD in Data Science, Computer Science, Bioinformatics, Engineering or a related field
* 2\+ years of leadership experience managing and growing engineering teams.
* Proven experience with Machine Learning (e.g. deep neural networks, supervised and unsupervised learning), preferably within image processing or processing of 3D data
* Solid software development skills, preferably in Python and C\#
* Mindset for quality, flexibility, creativity, emerging technologies


In our search for a new colleague, we always look for people with a cross\-disciplinary and open mindset. Through cooperation with program managers, project managers, developers, testers, and Regulatory Affair specialists; you will get an in\-depth understanding of all aspects of medical software development and use this to enable further growth and success.

**Get in touch now!**


Please do not hesitate to apply as soon for this exciting opportunity at one of Denmark’s most successful and fastest\-growing high\-tech companies, as applications will be processed continuously. The deadline for application is **10\. October**. We look forward to hearing from you.


We encourage all relevant applicants to apply. We are committed to celebrating human diversity, and we trust that the best way to reach outstanding business results, is by welcoming diverse people into our community.

**About us**


3Shape started with a simple idea \- to make 3D scanning better. First, we applied it to the hearing industry, then we succeeded in dentistry. Twenty years later, 3Shape has 2,000\+ employees globally. With the help of dental professionals and amazing colleagues we’re creating award\-winning scanning and CAD/CAM solutions to change dentistry together! Together, we contribute to a better world. Experience the everyday \#lifeat3Shape across the globe on LinkedIn.

jobs.title: Quality Automation Engineer
jobs.description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission\-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI\-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well\-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.  



  

**The Role**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission\-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI\-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well\-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.  



  

**The Role**

At Kyndryl, we design, build, manage and modernize mission\-critical technology systems for leading organizations around the world.
  

  

**Your Role**

Join our growing team in Singapore to support on\-premise and hybrid infrastructure platforms that underpin mission\-critical systems.  



  

**What You Will Do**

* Collaborate with Product Owners and Business Analysts to define clear and actionable user story acceptance criteria.
* Work with Software Engineers to ensure automated test coverage and prevent bugs and defects in production.
* Analyze and decompose complex software systems to design holistic, risk based test strategies.
* Develop and maintain test automation frameworks using industry\-standard tools.
* Design, implement, and execute comprehensive test suites covering functional, regression, exploratory, and performance testing
* Take a risk\-based approach to test automation, prioritizing critical functionality for maximum impact.
* Perform time\-boxed exploratory testing to uncover edge cases and usability issues.
* Maintain a stable regression test suite integrated into QA nightly builds.
* Continuously refine smoke tests in the Development CI environment for early issue detection.
* Lead system integration testing with other system owners to validate cross system interactions.
* Oversee User Acceptance Testing (UAT), coordinating with stakeholders to ensure business requirements are met.
* Manage the defect lifecycle, test artifacts, and test repositories to ensure clear tracking and reporting.
Drive continuous improvement in agile testing practices, tools, and methodologies.  
* 

  

**Your Future at Kyndryl**  

Kyndryl has a global footprint, which means that as a Quality Automation Engineer at Kyndryl you will have opportunities to work on projects and collaborate with colleagues from around the world. This role is dynamic and influential – offering a wide range of professional and personal growth opportunities that you won’t find anywhere else.  



  

  

  

  

  

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer\-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.  



  

**Required Skills and Experience**

  

**Core Testing Expertise:**

* Strong knowledge of test automation strategies and risk\-based testing
* Experience designing and executing test cases, test plans, and test suites
* Hands\-on experience with manual and automated testing for web, mobile, and API services
Familiarity with cross\-browser, cross\-platform, and responsive UI testing.  
* 

  

**Test Automation \& CI/CD Integration:**

* Experience with test automation frameworks such as Selenium, Playwright, Robot Framework, Cypress, SikuliX, or EggPlant.
* Knowledge of test scripting and automation programming using Python, Java, JavaScript, or C\#
* Experience integrating test automation into CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, Bamboo)
Ability to design maintainable, scalable, and reusable test automation suites.  
* 

  

**Agile \& DevOps Testing Practices:**

* Strong understanding of agile testing methodologies, including TDD, BDD, and exploratory testing.
* Experience working in agile development environments (Scrum, Kanban, XP)
* Familiarity with shift\-left testing approaches, ensuring early defect detection
* Experience with containerized testing in Docker/Kubernetes environments. Security \& Performance Testing (Added Advantage):
* Experience with performance testing tools (JMeter, Gatling, k6, Locust)
* Knowledge of application security testing (OWASP ZAP, Burp Suite, SAST, DAST)
Experience conducting API security testing using authentication protocols (OAuth, JWT)  
* 

  

**Test Management \& Certifications:**

* Experience managing defect tracking and test repositories using tools such as JIRA, TestRail, Micro Focus ALM (QC/Sprinter)
* Certified Software Testing Professional (CSTP) and/or Certified Software Quality Analyst (CSQA) is an advantage.
Degree or Diploma in Computer Science, Computer or Electronics Engineering, Information Technology, or related disciplines.  
* 

  

  

  

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.  



  

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid\-friendly culture that supports your well\-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  

  

From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  

  

We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in\-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting\-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands\-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  

  

We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.


**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

jobs.description:
Job Description
  
  

* Design and implement back\-end services in modern C\+\+(C\+\+17/20\) and C\#/.NET, including relational schema design, query optimization, transaction handling, and middleware integration; expose and consume interfaces over TCP/IP, REST, WebSocket, gRPC, and serial communication
* Develop Front\-end applications with angular and Vue, covering component architecture, state management, and reactive data flow, for both server\-side clients and machine\-mounted HMI and kiosk clients
* Develop and maintain cross\-compiled embedded C\+\+software for ARM64 Linux targets
* Work hands\-on with single\-board computer platforms (e.g., Raspberry Pi, NVIDIA Jetson): device setup and connectivity, Linux environment configuration, and deploying and troubleshooting software on target hardware
* Perform root\-cause analysis of failures on real machines and in the field using structured logs, traces, timing measurements, crash dumps, and hardware documentation, then design and implement the softwarefix, the recovery behavior, and the regression test
* Contribute to technical specifications: identify gaps, ambiguities, and conflicts in incomplete requirements, raise them withstakeholders early, and author traceable requirements documentation(SWRD\-style, with ticket\-linked requirement IDs) covering functional, interface, performance, and error\-handling requirements
* Design and develop product features together with mechanical, electrical, and software teams across several countries; run design and code reviews, verification and validation activities, and technical evaluation of third\-party components including bench testing
* Contribute to computer vision, image processing, and3D vision work for automated inspection (camera and illumination interfacing, calibration, feature extraction and measurement, and AI/ML\-assisted defect classification); prior experience is welcome but not required, and training will be provided.


Job Requirements
  
  

Education
  
  

* Bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related field


Work experience
  
  

* ≥3 years' experience in full\-stack software development, including products released to customers and maintained across multiple release cycles (fresh graduates also welcome to apply if relevant experience shown)


Expertise and methodology
  
  

* Product development and use of development tools: Visual Studio Professional/Code, static analysis, AI coding assistants (Copilot, Claude Code)
* Programming languages: modern C\+\+ (C\+\+17/20, STL, templates, smart pointers); C\#/.NET is good to have but not required
* Front\-end development — Angular or Vue preferred; candidates with React or strong TypeScript experience are also considered, provided they are willing to learn Angular and Vue: component architecture, state management, reactive and observable data flow, and build tooling
* Multi\-threaded and concurrent programming
* Databases: relational schema design, SQL, indexing, and transaction handling from C\+\+ and C\#
* Communication technology: familiarity with TCP/IP, REST, WebSocket, gRPC, and serial communication; awareness of interface versioning and backward compatibility
* Unit, integration, and regression testing, and Design for testability
* Debugging and root\-cause analysis on real hardware: log and trace analysis, reproducing intermittent and timing\-dependent faults
* Version control (Git): branching and merging strategies, and code review
* Software Development Life Cycle, with basic understanding of Agile methodologies and lifecycle models
* Proficient and disciplined use of AI coding assistants to accelerate development, while maintaining full understanding, code quality, and accountability for all code produced
* Good to have:


o Basic working knowledge of Jira and Confluence for issue tracking, sprint work, and technical documentation
  
  

**o Embedded, cross\-compiled C\+\+ development for ARM64 Linux:** toolchains, sysroots, cross\-debugging, and hardware abstraction
  
  

o Single\-board computer platforms (e.g., Raspberry Pi, NVIDIA Jetson): setup, connectivity, and working in a Linux environment on target hardware
  
  

o Basic microcontroller and firmware knowledge (e.g., STM32 or similar): peripherals (GPIO, UART, SPI, I²C) and interrupt handling
  
  

o Computer vision, image processing, and 3D vision (e.g., OpenCV, point cloud processing)
  
  

o Python
  
  

Other requirement
  
  

* Communication skills (verbal and written), including presenting and defending technical designs to non\-software engineers
* Social competences to work in cross\-cultural andinternational environment
* Sense of ownership and responsibility for assignedwork, including its quality after release
* Diligence and attention to detail in released software
* Goal\-driven and independent working style
* Willingness to learn and openness to feedback
* Willingness to travel internationally to customer sites and other Komax locations

#### **About Us**


**About the Company**


The JERA Global Markets Group (JERAGM) is a leading utility\-backed energy trader. A joint venture between majority shareholder JERA Co., Inc. and EDF Trading Ltd, JERAGM's shareholders are among the world's major utilities.


JERAGM operates one of the most exciting energy portfolios in the world which gives it an in\-depth understanding of the way local, regional and international energy markets behave. Its in\-depth knowledge and market insights enable us to capture trading opportunities, optimise portfolios, create value and enhance security of supply for our customers.


Headquartered in Singapore, JERAGM has a global talent pool of about 400 people across offices located in five strategic locations: Singapore, the UK (London), Japan (Tokyo), the US (Houston) and Australia (Brisbane).


JERA Global Markets Pte. Ltd. is strongly capitalised with over US$500 million in paid up capital and has retained its AA\-Stable rating from R\&I, attributable to a robust business model and solid financial base. JERAGM has a total equity of US$3\.4 billion (as of 1 April 2025\).


#### **Job Description**


**Position Description**


JERAGM require an experienced software engineer to support a journey of technical transformation alongside analysts within the Middle Office function. The engineer is expected to specify, design, develop, improve and optimise systems to, for example:


* Automate and scale processes, including data validation and PNL attribution, and enhance them with modern tools, such as Azure and AI;
* Value energy transactions, both financial and physical transactions including a linear and non\-linear payoffs;
* Calculation of financial performance, Marked to Market and Profit and Loss measures;
* Assess financial market risk for the organisation, i.e. VaR or related measures;
* Processes for the statistical estimation of market parameters;
* Source market and fundamental data, and support the development of a platform to access this data;
* Store data for future consumption and build interfaces, including libraries and APIs, for efficiently accessing the data;
* Redesign ETL systems/services to fit better in the long term development plan of the company

The role is intended to be a core technical resource in the technical evolution of the Middle Office function. Acting as a conduit with the wider IT teams to provide analysts in the risk and control teams at JERAGM with a best practice technology platform to build the Middle Office reporting tools. The current tools are implemented in a variety of techniques and technologies ranging from Excel spreadsheets and Python tools, both on local desktops and in the cloud.


These tools are often developed rapidly to meet emerging business needs, and over time become essential operational tools. This role will support the Middle Office function by providing guidance as to how to best make use of the technology and by adding the technical firepower to keep these tools robust and performant.


Working closely with the business, this role will identify where more strategic solutions are required and will then help to deliver such work by developing robust, supportable and architecturally\-aligned systems, frameworks and infrastructure.


**Role Responsibilities:**


* Support and transform existing tools, models and analytics, often written in Excel and Python, into modern cloud based systems.
* Collaborate with both the IT and Middle Office teams to ensure that solutions are engineered appropriately for their scale, criticality and strategic importance.
* Have a strong engineering focus and eye for high quality delivery. They will be expected to build robust, high\-quality systems using modern software engineering techniques including automated unit/integration testing, continuous integration and automated deployment. They must also be driven to automate everything as this is ingrained in the culture of the rest of the team and provides significant long term benefit.
* Take ownership of their own learning/research to gain a deep understanding of how JERAGM's business teams operate and how the full transaction cycle within a multi\-commodity energy trading environment works. This is essential to facilitate direct communication with users and other stakeholders with minimal hand\-holding from Business Analysts
* Provide 3rd line production support for systems developed
* Work closely with other IT stakeholders to ensure that solutions are in alignment with IT strategy around business architecture, infrastructure architecture and technology. JERAGM make heavy use of the Azure platform and Microsoft technologies such as .NET for more tackling more robust software problems. The Middle Office Software Engineer will be responsible for aligning their solutions to this high level strategy.
* Work with the IT Operations/Infrastructure team to deploy solutions into JERAGM's IT infrastructure in a sustainable way.
* Work with other IT stakeholders to ensure that there is excellent continuity of knowledge. This may mean writing documentation or taking part in handover workshops.
* Contribute to the AI journey of the team.
#### **Qualifications**


**Technical Qualifications Required:**


* Strong academic background, educated to degree level and/or equivalent professional qualification or relevant business experience.
* The ideal candidate would have worked for at least 5 years in a business\-facing development role for a team within a commodity trading organisation. Strong candidates from good tech houses will also be considered.
* Solid experience with at least one statically\-typed language: C\# (strongly preferred), Java, Go, Rust etc
* Strong interest and ability to write clean, modular, maintainable code
* Database design (both relational and non\-relational) and development
* Strong ability to architect and design solutionsusing the following techniques and software engineering patterns:
	+ Data modelling
	+ Distributed Messaging Systems
	+ Service Oriented and Microservices Architecture (REST and RPC styles)
	+ System decomposition (functional, object\-oriented, service\-oriented)
	+ CQRS, Event Sourcing, n\-tier architecture
* Excellent understanding of code and systems design patterns
* Experience with different types of test automation, such as unit testing, contract testing, integration testing, end to end testing, mutation testing etc
* Strong experience with Azure preferred, however other cloud providers are acceptable
* Inclination for automating repetitive tasks
* Solid understanding of data structures, algorithms

**Nice to haves:**


* Experience with **Python**, especially in a quantitative environment, and an understanding of its strengths and weaknesses; familiarity with static analysis tools and modern package and environment managers.
* Understanding and passion for **functional programming**, including principles and common design patterns
* Experience developing containerised microservice architectures using technologies such as **Docker and Kubernetes**
* Working technical knowledge of Risk / Middle Office techniques and methodologies, including **PNL Attribution,** **Marked to Market, Value at Risk, Liquidity risk and Credit risk measures (PFE)**
* Proficiency with modern web development with a tool such as **Angular** or **React**
* Exposure to **Devops**, build and release pipeline management
* A strong **sense of aesthetics and a keen eye for detail**, as well as the ability to work with various design and wireframing tools
* Passion for **technical writing**

**Person Specifications:**


* It is most important that the candidate has the ability and desire to rapidly pick up a diverse range of technical skills to support challenges as they arise. Support, resources and technical mentoring will be provided by JERAGM as required.
* Highly motivated to deliver results and to find the right balance between speedy deliveries and robust engineering.
* Have a strong sense of ownership of development and delivery end to end.
* Curious and innovative.
* Able to work with minimal supervision and highly structured and organised in the way tasks are approached.
* Excellent communication skills.

**Other Information**


This role offers an excellent opportunity to further develop skills and responsibility within a growing and successful commodity trading business.

At Kairostek, we believe great technology starts with great people.


We foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous growth, empowering our team to make a meaningful impact while building solutions that shape the future. Our teams work across software engineering, artificial intelligence, cloud infrastructure, cybersecurity, digital products, payments technology, and technology operations to deliver scalable and innovative solutions for global organizations.

We are looking for an experienced Software Architect with 10\+ years of software engineering experience and 3\+ years of architectural/technical leadership experience to drive the design and evolution of scalable iGaming and eGaming platforms.


The ideal candidate has strong expertise in C\#/.NET, microservices, DDD, TDD, cloud\-native architecture, and hands\-on experience with online casino, game provider, aggregator, wallet, and eGaming integrations.

* Design and lead scalable C\#/.NET microservices and distributed systems.

* Design cloud\-native solutions using Azure, AKS, Kubernetes, Docker, Azure SQL, Cosmos DB, and Redis.

* 10\+ years of professional software engineering experience.

* Strong hands\-on expertise in C\#/.NET and ASP.NET Core.
* Strong experience with Microservices, DDD, TDD, REST APIs, and event\-driven architecture.
* Strong iGaming experience is required, particularly online casino and game provider integrations.
* Experience with casino aggregators, wallets, payments, player platforms, or gaming APIs.
* Strong Azure, Kubernetes, Docker, and CI/CD experience.
* Excellent problem\-solving, communication, and technical leadership skills.

* Competitive compensation package.
* Flexible and remote\-friendly work environment.
* Professional growth and development opportunities.
* Exposure to international projects and teams.
* Collaborative and inclusive company culture.
* Opportunity to work with modern technologies and innovative solutions.

Kairostek is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We welcome applications from qualified candidates regardless of race, ethnicity, gender, age, disability, religion, sexual orientation, or background.
