**Neptune Lines Shipping and Managing Enterprises (Neptune Lines), part of Neptune Group**, is a leading finished vehicle logistics provider, specializing in transportation and shipping solutions for manufacturers and shippers of cars and high and heavy cargoes. Operating across Europe, North Africa, and the Black Sea, Neptune Lines excels in short\-sea shipping, connecting ports with efficient and specialized services. As a trusted partner for major car manufacturers, Neptune Lines delivers tailored solutions that meet the highest industry standards. Guided by its "Wake Forward" philosophy, Neptune Lines is committed to sustainability, reliability, and customer satisfaction, delivering operational excellence that drives progress in the logistics industry.

  

  

We are seeking a talented and tech\-savvy **Business Applications \& Support Engineer** to join our **Digital Transformation team**. You will play a key role in supporting, optimizing and continuously enhancing our core business systems and ERP applications. Acting as a vital link between technology, business operations, end\-users and external vendors, you will translate business needs into effective digital solutions, oversee system improvements and contribute to the successful delivery of transformation initiatives.

  

  

The position reports directly to the **Digital Transformation Manager**.

  

  

**Key Responsibilities**


* Analyze, support and enhance core business systems and enterprise applications, including ERP systems, ensuring alignment with operational workflows and business requirements.
* Design and develop tailored in\-house applications or custom scripts, as required, to address specific business needs.
* Act as the primary liaison between internal end\-users and external software vendors, facilitating effective communication and accelerating issue resolution.
* Oversee system installations, upgrades and configurations carried out by external vendors, ensuring timely, efficient and high\-quality project delivery.
* Design and execute comprehensive end\-to\-end testing and User Acceptance Testing (UAT) to ensure system reliability and seamless performance.
* Deliver engaging training sessions and develop clear user documentation to support end\-users and promote the successful adoption of new technologies.
* Develop and deliver a wide range of reports, dashboards and data insights, supporting business continuity and providing Top Management with valuable information for decision\-making.
  

  

**Required Qualifications**


* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering or a closely related field.
* Experience: At least two years of relevant professional experience in application support, business analysis, ERP implementation or a related field.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in Greek and English (a third language will be considered an asset).
  

  

**Skills**


* Strong hands\-on knowledge of relational database management systems, with particular emphasis on Microsoft SQL Server and T\-SQL.
* Familiarity with at least one major programming language, such as Python, C\#, Java, PHP or VB.
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to prioritize tasks and manage multiple responsibilities effectively in a fast\-paced environment.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills in both Greek and English, including the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non\-technical audiences.
* A proactive and collaborative team player who can also work independently, quickly adapt to emerging technologies and demonstrate a strong commitment to continuous improvement.
* Experience with Business Intelligence tools, such as Power BI or QlikView, and the ability to transform raw data into meaningful and actionable dashboards will be considered an asset.
* Familiarity with Robotic Process Automation (RPA) and workflow automation tools, such as Power Automate or UiPath, will be considered an asset.
  

  

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and are committed to ensuring that our employment practices do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, age, marital status, medical condition, disability, or any other legally protected status. **Electrical and Automation Engineer**
======================================

Requisition ID: 19377
Location:
Zug, CH, 6300
Pay Type:
Holcim is the leading partner for sustainable construction, creating value across the built environment from infrastructure and industry to buildings. Headquartered in Zug, Switzerland, Holcim has more than 48,000 employees in 45 attractive markets – across Europe, Latin America, Asia, Middle East \& Africa. Holcim offers high\-value end\-to\-end Building Materials and Building Solutions, from foundations and flooring to roofing and walling – powered by premium brands including ECOPlanet, ECOPact, and ECOCycle®. Find out more at www.holcim.com


**WHO IS HOLCIM?**
  

As a global leader in innovative and sustainable building solutions, Holcim is enabling greener cities, smarter infrastructure and improving living standards around the world. With sustainability at the core of our strategy, we are becoming a net\-zero company, with our people and communities at the heart of our success. We are driving circular construction as a world leader in recycling to build more with less. It’s all thanks to our 70,000 talented people around the world who are passionate about building progress for people and the planet through four business segments: Cement, Ready\-Mix Concrete, Aggregates and Solutions \& Products.


**WHO ARE HOLCIM PEOPLE**
  

Holcim people are passionate about finding better ways to build. They embrace innovation and improvement with a pioneering spirit. They work as trusted partners, creating better solutions and experiences for their customers, communities, and colleagues.

  

Holcim is the leading partner for sustainable construction with net sales of CHF 15\.7 billion in 2025, creating value across the built environment from infrastructure and industry to buildings. Headquartered in Zug, Switzerland, Holcim has more than 50 000 employees in 45 countries – across Europe, Latin America and Asia, Middle East \& Africa – and has been recognized as a Global Top Employer by the Top Employers Institute. Holcim offers high\-value end\-to\-end Building Materials and Building Solutions, from foundation and flooring to walling and roofing – powered by premium brands including ECOPact, ECOPlanet, ECOCycle, and Ytong.

  

**Role Overview**

  

Support the Holcim Group and provide advanced electrical and automation engineering support for greenfield and brownfield plants across all project phases (definition, planning, and execution) as our **Electrical and Automation Engineer based in Zug Switzerland**. This role focuses on industrial CAPEX projects in Cement and Geocycle operations globally as well as large\-scale Carbon Capture, Utilization, and Storage (CCUS) initiatives

  

**Main Responsibilities**

  

**Health, Safety \& Environment (HSE)**  

* Drive a strong safety culture across all engineering activities, integrating "Safety in Design" and "Safety in Construction" principles.

* Ensure full compliance with Group HSE standards, security policies, and technical regulations across all assigned projects.

**Project Conceptualization \& Feasibility**  

* Develop robust, safe, and cost\-effective electrical and automation engineering concepts for business cases, feasibility studies, and tender packages.

* Analyse plant KPIs to assist CAPEX Project Managers in establishing accurate CAPEX/OPEX estimates and production targets.

* Evaluate tender submissions to identify technically sound, commercially optimal solutions.

**Detailed Engineering \& Quality Control**  

* Review detailed design documentation to ensure compliance with Group standards, safety requirements, maintainability, durability, and cost efficiency.

* Oversee quality control, technical inspections, and execution of electrical and automation packages during project implementation.

* Provide targeted, high\-value technical support during the commissioning and performance\-testing phases.

**Supplier Management \& Technical Governance**  

* Qualify global suppliers for electrical systems, power distribution, and drive technologies, maintaining a strong understanding of market capabilities.

* Develop and continuously refine standard design criteria, engineering tools (e.g., eDM, IBS), and technical best practices across the organization.

* Represent the discipline in knowledge\-sharing platforms and cross\-functional technical roundtables.

**Project \& Stakeholder Management**  

* Simultaneously manage electrical and automation deliverables across multiple concurrent projects based on priority.

* Collaborate effectively within diverse, multicultural, and multidisciplinary engineering teams across international locations.

**Your Profile**

  

* **Education:** University degree in Electrical Engineering, Automation Engineering, or a closely related discipline.

* **Experience:** Minimum 5 years of hands\-on experience in industrial CAPEX project engineering (Cement, Heavy Industry, or Process Engineering preferred).

### **Technical \& Functional Skills**

  

* Deep knowledge of international electrical and automation engineering standards, tools, and methodologies.

* Proven experience in large\-scale CAPEX project execution, tender preparation, and vendor selection.

* Familiarity with heavy process industries (e.g., Cement, Energy, Carbon Capture).

  

  

### **Leadership \& Behavioural Competencies**

  

* **Technical Leadership:** Ability to influence stakeholders and establish credibility through technical expertise rather than direct authority.

* **Adaptability \& Resilience:** Comfortable working autonomously, managing shifting priorities, and conducting site assessments in remote or challenging environments.

* **Communication \& Negotiation:** Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to bridge complex technical details with commercial and operational teams across global sites.

* **Mindset:** Highly analytical, rigorous, cost\-conscious, and open to continuous improvement and technical innovation.

### **Languages \& Mobility**

  

* **Languages:** Professional working proficiency in English (written and spoken) is required. Proficiency in additional core Group languages is a plus.

* **Mobility:** Willingness to travel frequently to project locations, supplier facilities, and construction sites worldwide, including regions with basic infrastructure or remote conditions.

  

  

  

**Benefits**

  

* Hybrid work contract
* Family Support: Subsidized child care and paid maternity/paternity leave
* Professional Growth: Company\-sponsored training and professional development.
* Discounts and Perks: Subsidized meals, exclusive discounts, and company gifts for special occasions.
* Long\-service awards
* Employee referral bonus
* Pension and Savings: Access to a comprehensive pension fund and an employee savings scheme.

*Holcim is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. We support equal opportunities for everyone, regardless of race, national origin, gender, sexuality, disability, or age.*

  

*Important Notice: Holcim recruiters only contact candidates via official @\[holcim.com] email addresses. We do not use Gmail or any other non\-Holcim domains to conduct recruitment processes. Please verify the sender address before responding."*

  

Do you want to work in an international and dynamic working environment with attractive benefits? We are looking for colleagues to join our team to build progress for people and the planet.


Please submit your CV, a motivation letter and relevant documents with information on the career portal. No agencies can be considered.

jobs.title: Senior Pre-sales Solution Architect - Enterprise AI infrastructure (remote in the EU)
jobs.description:
**Company Description** **About Mirantis**


Mirantis is the Kubernetes\-native AI infrastructure company, enabling organizations to build and operate scalable, secure, and sovereign infrastructure for modern AI, machine learning, and data\-intensive applications. By combining open source innovation with deep expertise in Kubernetes orchestration, Mirantis empowers platform engineering teams to deliver composable, production\-ready developer platforms across any environment—on\-premises, in the cloud, at the edge, or in sovereign data centers. As enterprises navigate the growing complexity of AI\-driven workloads, Mirantis delivers the automation, GPU orchestration, and policy\-driven control needed to manage infrastructure with confidence and agility. Committed to open standards and freedom from lock\-in, Mirantis ensures that customers retain full control of their infrastructure strategy.

 **Job Description**  

The Opportunity


Mirantis helped define cloud native infrastructure for a generation of enterprises through our Container and OpenStack platforms — the systems that run mission\-critical workloads inside the world's most regulated organizations. Now those same customers are facing a new set of challenges as agentic AI and inferencing workloads grow explosively, and we're building the next infrastructure chapter to meet them there.


We are seeking a dynamic and technically strong Sales Engineer / Pre\-Sales Solution Architect to help customers design and deploy next\-generation AI infrastructure in the French speaking areas of Europe.


We're looking for a Sales Engineer who wants to own that transition inside real accounts: banking, insurance, telecom, government, pharma. This is enterprise infrastructure, not experimental AI — the customer's platform and security teams will be in the room, and your technical credibility is what earns their trus


In this role, you will work closely with our European enterprise customers, platform engineering teams, and AI practitioners to architect solutions that enable scalable AI workloads, modern developer platforms, and Kubernetes\-based infrastructure across hybrid and multi\-cloud environments.


This is not a support role. You own the architecture conversation, the proof\-of\-concept, and the depth of the customer relationship. Account teams partner with you — the technical trust is yours to build.


What You'll Actually Do

* Own the technical relationship. Be the person CTOs, platform teams, and infrastructure leaders trust for a straight answer — not just the one who runs the demo.
* Architect real solutions. Translate a customer's constraints — regulatory, operational, organizational — into deployable architecture across our Container, OpenStack, and Enterprise AI offerings.
* Lead the proof. Run PoCs that prove fit under real conditions: deploy the platform, prototype AI workloads, debug live, and show what running it operationally actually looks like.
* Tell the story. Turn infrastructure complexity into a narrative a CIO and a platform engineer can each act on — in a boardroom, a workshop, or on a whiteboard.
* Build and protect the account. Carry technical continuity from discovery through PoC through expansion — especially in regulated environments where trust is earned slowly and lost fast.
* Win net\-new. Bring the same credibility to greenfield opportunities across regulated verticals, where the AI infrastructure conversation is often just starting.
* Shape what we build. Feed field insight back into product and GTM as our Enterprise AI infrastructure evolves — your input carries real weight.

 **Qualifications**  

Who You Are

* You've lived the cloud native rise. Kubernetes, containers, OpenStack, platform engineering — you've built and operated this, likely as a platform engineer, DevOps engineer, or cloud architect, before moving toward the customer.
* You're pulled toward AI infrastructure. GPU orchestration, inferencing, model serving — you're already leaning in, not waiting to be asked.
* You think in platforms, not tools. Compute, networking, storage, and now inference and governance — one architecture, not a checklist.
* You can deploy what you sell. You stand up clusters, run live demos, build PoCs, and debug them yourself when something breaks in front of the customer.
* You own relationships, not tickets. You've managed accounts in regulated, high\-scrutiny environments and know that technical trust is the actual sales cycle.
* You're a natural technical evangelist. Conference talks, open\-source contributions, technical writing, demo\-building — this is already how you show up.


What Actually Matters Most


Driving demonstrable outcomes and results is what we care about most. We want someone with a proven track record of leading technical evaluations that turn into signed deals — and who can tell you exactly how they did it.


Equally important: proven technical authority in regulated enterprise environments, where the sales cycle runs through platform and security review as much as procurement. This is relationship development and technical account management as much as it is architecture.


Practical Requirements

* 12 years combined experience across infrastructure engineering and solutions architecture / sales engineering.
* 5\+ years in Sales Engineering, Solutions Architecture, or Technical Consulting in France or other French speaking countries in Europe.
* Hands\-on experience designing or operating Kubernetes and/or OpenStack\-based systems in production.
* Proven track record supporting enterprise sales cycles for infrastructure or cloud platforms.
* Experience managing accounts in regulated industries (banking/FSI, telecom, government, pharma/manufacturing) strongly preferred.

  

Why This Role

* A ground\-floor seat in Mirantis' Enterprise AI infrastructure business, backed by an installed base of 1,500 enterprise customers.
* Technical ownership, not a scripted demo role — you architect, you build the PoC, you own the trust.
* A direct line from field insight to product and GTM as our Enterprise AI infrastructure evolves

 **Additional Information** **What does Mirantis offer you?**  

* Work with an established Silicon Valley leader in the cloud infrastructure industry;
* Work with exceptionally passionate, talented and engaging colleagues, helping Fortune 500 and Global 2000 customers implement next\-generation cloud technologies;
* Be a part of cutting\-edge, open\-source innovation;
* Thrive in the high\-energy environment of a young company where openness, collaboration, risk\-taking, and continuous growth are valued;
* Professional development and training;
* Attend conferences and working groups;
* Company outings, happy hours, hackathons, and tech talks;
* Receive a competitive compensation package with a strong benefits plan.

Actual base salary varies based on factors, including but limited to, relevant sill, prior experience, education, base salary of internal peers, demonstrated performance, and geographic location

 **It is understood that Mirantis, Inc. may use automated decision\-making technology (ADMT) for specific employment\-related decisions. Opting out of ADMT use is requested for decisions about evaluation and review connected with the specific employment decision for the position applied for. You also have the right to appeal any decisions made by ADMT by sending your request to isamoylova@mirantis.com**


By submitting your resume, you consent to the processing and storage of your personal data in accordance with applicable data protection laws, for the purposes of considering your application for current and future job opportunities.

This position offers a unique opportunity to work in a diverse IT environment, collaborate with experts across multiple domains, and gain hands\-on experience in IT support, service management, hardware lifecycle management, and process improvement.

**Your responsibilities:**


User Support \& Service Delivery

* Provide second\-line support for Business Computing applications, investigating and resolving user issues.
* Deliver technical assistance and guidance to users of Business Computing services and applications.
* Coordinate with application experts, IT specialists, service providers, and support teams to ensure timely resolution of incidents and service requests.


Hardware \& Asset Management

* Provide hardware\-related support to designated users and coordinate equipment interventions, office moves, and replacements.
* Manage computer equipment inventory, stock levels, asset tracking, and associated administrative processes.


Documentation \& Knowledge Management

* Create, maintain, and enhance technical documentation, software installation guides, knowledge base articles, and operational procedures for the team and Service Desk.


Operational Improvement \& Security Coordination

* Identify and implement opportunities to streamline and automate operational and administrative processes.

**Your profile:**


Experience in one or more of the following areas would be considered an advantage:

* Windows and Mac workstation administration and troubleshooting.
* Hardware deployment, inventory management, or asset management.
* IT support, help desk, service desk, or technical user support.

* IT service management practices and ticketing systems.


Skills:

* Interest in IT support, technology, and helping users.

* Strong problem\-solving and communication skills.

* Organised, reliable, and eager to learn.
* Interest in improving processes and finding efficient ways of working.
* Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.


Eligibility criteria:

* You are a national of a CERN Member or Associate Member State.

Job closing date: **14\.10\.2026 at 23:59 CEST.**

Working hours: 40 hours per week


Job flexibility: Fully Onsite


Target start date: 01\-January\-2027


This position involves:

* A valid driving licence.

Job reference: FAP\-BC\-IQS\-2026\-229\-GRAE


Field of work: Information Technologies


Benchmark job: 301130 \- Computing Technical Engineer

**Global Benefits**

**Overview of CERN \- Discover a world where the impossible is made possible!**


At CERN, the European Organization for Nuclear Research, we are pushing the frontiers of science and technology. Our groundbreaking work brings together not only physicists but also a diverse range of professionals from engineering, technical, scientific, and administrative fields. Together, we foster an environment where innovation and collaboration thrive.


Every day, we face exciting new challenges and opportunities to contribute to cutting\-edge research that shapes our understanding of the universe. We meet these challenges through the diverse perspectives within our teams, ensuring every contribution is valued and driving our shared sense of inclusion and purpose. Diversity is a core value of CERN since its foundation, and it remains central to our mission and continued success.


If you are ready to be part of a dynamic, inclusive community pushing the boundaries of knowledge, CERN is the place where your curiosity and skills can thrive. Be part of our mission to uncover what lies at the heart of the universe! **TAKE PART!**

jobs.title: Senior .NET Engineer | Arquitectura Aplicativa e IT4IT
jobs.description:
We are knowmad mood!


Somos una compañía líder en transformación digital, en constante evolución y a la vanguardia de la tecnología. Nacimos para provocar un cambio real a través de la innovación y el desarrollo sostenible, con la misión de aportar valor a los clientes e impulsar nuestro talento.


Formado por más de 3\.000 personas creativas, digitales e innovadoras conectadas a un propósito y capaces de generar conexiones con personas de todo el mundo. Un equipo responsable, flexible y con alta capacidad de adaptación a las necesidades de nuestros clientes y del mercado, a la vez que proporciona valor, visión, creatividad, expertise, profesionalidad y pasión por la tecnología en cada proyecto.


Los valores que marcan nuestro rumbo y nos guían hacia la excelencia son la colaboración, la innovación, el compromiso, la diversión y la conﬁanza.

 **¿Qué es lo que valoramos?**


Experiencia de al menos 5 años como Desarrollador Senior .NET o Consultor Técnico en entornos empresariales complejos:

* Experiencia sólida en desarrollo y mantenimiento de aplicaciones .NET y .NET Framework.
* Conocimientos avanzados en arquitectura de aplicaciones, refactorización de código, modernización tecnológica y gestión del ciclo de vida del software.
* Experiencia trabajando con observabilidad, monitorización y análisis de rendimiento mediante herramientas como Kibana, Grafana, Elastic Stack o similares.
* Conocimientos en actualización y migración de frameworks, dependencias y componentes tecnológicos en entornos productivos.
* Experiencia en la gestión y mitigación de vulnerabilidades de seguridad, tanto a nivel de código como de arquitectura e infraestructura.
* Capacidad para analizar dependencias técnicas complejas entre aplicaciones, servicios, sistemas operativos y componentes corporativos.
* Experiencia en documentación técnica, inventariado de aplicaciones y definición de relaciones entre sistemas.
* Capacidad de trabajo en equipo y comunicación efectiva con equipos técnicos, arquitectura, ciberseguridad y negocio..

**¿Cuáles serían tus funciones?**

* **Modernización y Evolución Aplicativa:** Refactorizar, optimizar, actualizar y sanear las aplicaciones actualmente en producción, garantizando su mantenibilidad, rendimiento y alineamiento con los estándares tecnológicos corporativos.
* **Observabilidad y Monitorización:** Diseñar e implementar métricas, trazabilidad y dashboards que permitan mejorar la observabilidad de las aplicaciones mediante herramientas como Kibana, Grafana y otras soluciones del ecosistema.
* **Gestión de Vulnerabilidades:** Analizar y mitigar vulnerabilidades identificadas por los equipos de ciberseguridad, impulsando tanto mejoras de código como actualizaciones de componentes, frameworks y plataformas.
* **Arquitectura e IT4IT:** Participar en iniciativas de arquitectura técnica y gobierno IT4IT, evaluando dependencias, definiendo soluciones de mejora continua y asegurando la sostenibilidad tecnológica de los sistemas.
* **Actualización Tecnológica:** Liderar procesos de actualización de frameworks, librerías, componentes y sistemas operativos cuando las aplicaciones presenten dependencias que lo requieran.
* **Documentación Técnica:** Mantener actualizado el inventario de aplicaciones y componentes, documentando la arquitectura desplegada y las relaciones existentes entre los diferentes sistemas.
* **Colaboración Multidisciplinaria:** Trabajar estrechamente con equipos de desarrollo, operaciones, arquitectura y ciberseguridad para garantizar la evolución continua de los entornos tecnológicos.

jobs.title: Gametech Innovation Developer
jobs.description:
**Job Description** **WHAT YOU WILL BE WORKING ON**  

  

**The Gametech Innovation team** is a specialized group of developers focused on empowering Gameloft’s game teams to create better games through innovative technological solutions. We focus on Unity and Unreal engines, developing tools and systems that span a wide range of game development needs.  

As a Mid\-Level **Developer** within the team, you will manage feature delivery and support the technical stability of our tools and systems, contributing to the full lifecycle of each solution.

**What it means on a daily basis**

* Own features or subsystems end\-to\-end, from benchmarking existing solutions and prototyping alternatives through to implementing and shipping the final tool to game teams
* Write maintainable, self\-explanatory code in C\+\+ and C\# within Unreal and Unity engines
* Debug and profile tools and systems across engines and target platforms (console, PC, mobile) so they stay reliable in production
* Maintain and extend the team's CI/CD and build pipelines so new tool versions reach game teams continuously
* Use AI coding assistants in your daily workflow, experiment with new approaches and technologies, and propose the incremental improvements worth industrialising

**What success will look like**


In your first three months, you will be at ease in the team's codebase and delivering fixes and features on existing tools with limited guidance. From there, you will own a feature or subsystem end\-to\-end, you will propose improvements to tools and workflows on your own initiative and become a technical point of contact for the game teams we support.

**Who you would be working with**


You will be reporting to our Gametech Innovation Manager, and collaborate very closely with other Developers from the Gametech Innovation team across multiple studios worldwide, including Paris, Montreal, Bucharest, and others, offering opportunities to collaborate with colleagues from diverse backgrounds and perspectives. Day to day you will work with game programmers, technical artists and producers on Gameloft's game teams internationally.

**Your recruitment journey**

* First interview: A conversation to explore how the role aligns with your background and to address your main questions.
* Test: You will receive a short case study to complete.
* Second interview: You will meet members of our technical team to present your test and talk through your approach, reasoning, and methodologies in more depth.
* Final interview: You will meet a Hiring Manager to discuss your experience, vision, and how you approach game technology topics at a broader level.

**Where this role can take you**


This role can be a stepping stone toward a more senior position within the Gametech Innovation team, or toward specialising in a particular area such as engine, pipeline or platform technology. Internal training and mentoring from the team's senior developers are available, and internal mobility across teams and studios is possible through Gameloft's Talent Move programme.

 **Qualifications** **WHAT YOU NEED TO SUCCEED**

* Solid proficiency with Unreal Engine and/or Unity; and in C\+\+ and C\#
* Practical use of AI coding assistants in your day\-to\-day development work
* Good debugging and profiling skills across multiple systems, together with the ability to write clean, maintainable and self\-explanatory code
* Working knowledge of CI/CD and build pipelines

**WHO YOU ARE**

* Naturally curious: you enjoy digging into unfamiliar problems and exploring new engines, tools and approaches
* Solution\-driven: you turn ambiguous, poorly defined requests into workable technical paths, treat constraints as problems to solve, and propose improvements beyond your assigned scope to keep the team moving forward

  

**Additional Information** **WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU**

**Benefits**

* Permanent contract, full\-time employment with comprehensive Social Benefits.
* 25 vacation days per year \+ Birthday day off.
* Private medical health insurance.
* Flexible compensation with Ticket Restaurant Card.
* Free language courses.
* Work\-from\-home hybrid model.
* Merit based salary progression system and a competitive initial salary package.

  

**Life at** **Gameloft**


Our Barcelona studio offers real career development opportunities and a positive working environment in a centrally located office. We value supportive working conditions and a balanced work\-life approach, and our teams work together with a collaborative mindset.  

  

**Ready to level up your career? Apply now with your CV in English.**

jobs.title: Vulnerability Management Engineer, Madrid
jobs.description:
Vulnerability Management Engineer
  
Seleccionamos un Vulnerability Management Engineer especializado en Application Security para integrarse directamente en el equipo de ciberseguridad de una compañía del sector tecnológico.
  
  

Buscamos a un profesional técnico con experiencia en la detección, priorización y mitigación de riesgos de seguridad en aplicaciones Web, Mobile y Cloud. El candidato ideal aportará una sólida base técnica en el análisis de código y la capacidad de coordinar soluciones de remediación efectivas junto a los equipos de desarrollo.
  
  

Responsabilidades principales
  
  

**Evaluación de vulnerabilidades:** Ejecutar análisis SAST, DAST y SCA, asegurando que los hallazgos reportados sean precisos, accionables y alineados con el nivel de riesgo del negocio.
  
**Triage y validación:** Descartar falsos positivos, documentar las vulnerabilidades confirmadas y realizar pruebas de re\-testing para verificar la efectividad de las soluciones aplicadas.
  
**Integración en el ciclo de vida (SDLC):** Colaborar en la automatización e integración de los escaneos de seguridad dentro de los pipelines de CI/CD.
  
**Interlocución técnica:** Traducir los hallazgos de seguridad en recomendaciones técnicas claras, facilitando los planes de remediación con los equipos de desarrollo e infraestructura.
  
**Métricas y reporte:** Mantener y evolucionar cuadros de mando para el seguimiento de métricas clave (como SLAs de remediación y MTTR).
  
  

Perfil requerido
  
  

Entre 5 y 7 años de experiencia contrastada en seguridad de aplicaciones o gestión de vulnerabilidades.
  
Comprensión profunda de las vulnerabilidades del OWASP Top 10 y principios de arquitectura segura.
  
Dominio de Burp Suite para pruebas manuales en Web y APIs (validación de lógica de negocio, autenticación y autorización).
  
Experiencia con herramientas como Fortify, Checkmarx, SonarQube, Black Duck, Tenable o Nmap.
  
Capacidad de automatización mediante lenguajes de scripting (Python, Java, .NET o similares).

jobs.title: Enterprise Architect
jobs.description:
### **Enterprise Architect**


Lead the development and execution of the enterprise architecture strategy, ensuring alignment between business objectives, digital transformation initiatives, and technology investments. The ideal candidate will possess extensive experience in enterprise\-wide architecture, technology governance, application modernization, cloud transformation, and strategic roadmap planning across complex business environments.


The Enterprise Architect will define and maintain enterprise architecture frameworks, standards, principles, and target\-state architectures across business, application, data, integration, security, and technology domains. Working closely with executive leadership, business stakeholders, solution architects, and IT teams, the role will drive architectural consistency, technology standardization, and long\-term scalability across the organization.


Key responsibilities include evaluating emerging technologies, guiding enterprise\-wide technology decisions, overseeing cloud adoption strategies (AWS/Azure), and ensuring architecture compliance with security, risk, and governance requirements. The role will establish reference architectures and best practices for API management, microservices, integration platforms, containerization, infrastructure automation, and enterprise data management.


The successful candidate will have a strong background in enterprise architecture, system integration, cloud\-native technologies, and large\-scale transformation programs. Experience with technologies such as webMethods, Kubernetes, AWS S3, PostgreSQL, MSSQL, Redis, Java Spring Boot, .NET Core, Docker, Jenkins, and Terraform is highly desirable. Familiarity with enterprise architecture frameworks such as TOGAF, ArchiMate, or Zachman is preferred.


Excellent leadership, stakeholder management, communication, and documentation skills are essential to influence strategic technology decisions, chair architecture review boards, mentor architecture teams, and effectively present complex solutions to both technical and non\-technical audiences.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Define and maintain the organization's Enterprise Architecture vision, strategy, and technology roadmap.
* Establish enterprise architecture standards, principles, governance processes, and reference architectures.
* Ensure alignment between business strategy, digital transformation initiatives, and technology investments.
* Lead architecture reviews and provide governance oversight across major programs and projects.
* Drive cloud transformation and modernization initiatives across AWS, Azure, and hybrid environments.
* Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend strategic adoption opportunities.
* Collaborate with business and technology leaders to optimize application, data, and infrastructure portfolios.
* Promote enterprise\-wide integration, API, security, and data architecture best practices.
* Guide Solution Architects and technical teams to ensure architectural consistency and compliance.
* Support risk management, regulatory compliance, cybersecurity, and business continuity requirements.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field.
* 12\+ years of IT experience with at least 5 years in Enterprise Architecture.
* TOGAF Certification preferred.
* Experience in enterprise technology governance and architecture review boards.
* Strong understanding of cloud platforms, integration architecture, data architecture, and security architecture.
* Experience within Banking, Financial Services, or large enterprise environments is highly desirable.


This version positions the role at a **strategic, enterprise\-wide level**, which is the key distinction between an Enterprise Architect and a Solution Architect.

**Skills:** Enterprise Architecture , Cloud Transformation , Technology Governance

new_jobs.title: Senior Product Engineer - Pensions and Spend
new_jobs.description:
**Senior Product Engineer \- Investments**

**About Kota**


Kota is reimagining insurance and retirement benefits for the modern workforce. Through our two flagship products \- Kota Platform, the first fully integrated benefits platform, and Kota Embed, our embedded insurance solution \- we're making benefits more accessible, valued, and global.


Today, we power benefits for tens of thousands of employees at Europe's most forward\-thinking companies, including Carwow, Tines, Zoe, and Remote. Founded in 2022, we've raised more than €20M from leading investors such as EQT Ventures, Eurazeo, Northzone, and Frontline, as well as founders and executives from Workday, Remote, Personio, OpenAI, and more.

 **The role \& team**


We're looking for a Senior Product Engineer to join the Investments team, building the product that powers workplace pensions, retirement savings and our spend product at Kota. It's a full stack role with a backend lean, your strongest expertise will be backend and you'll work in the frontend when the product needs it.


The Investments team owns more than pensions. On one side, pension infrastructure is genuinely complex: multi\-provider, multi\-market and largely unmodernised. You'll design the systems that connect pension providers to employers and employees, covering contributions, fund data, payroll integrations and compliance across multiple markets.


On the other hand, you'll own our Spend product. This lets employers create allowances and issue cards to employees, who get a virtual Stripe card they can add to Apple or Google Wallet and spend in real time. It spans card issuing, wallet provisioning, transaction flows and the controls employers need to manage it. We want someone who starts with the customer, not the code, and proactively adds to the roadmap rather than just picking up tickets. This is an autonomous role, you'll be trusted to make product calls, not just technical ones.

 **What you'll do**

* Design and build the systems that power Kota's Investments products; pensions, retirement savings and Spend: contributions, onboarding, provider integrations, employer\-facing configuration, card issuing and wallet provisioning
* Own technical architecture for the Investments stream, integrating with external pension and savings providers as well as payment and card infrastructure (Stripe)
* Contribute to frontend code (React \+ TypeScript) when a feature calls for it
* Join client calls where it helps you understand or explain a problem, and proactively shape the roadmap rather than just picking up tickets
* Use AI actively in your day\-to\-day work, for building, reviewing and speeding up how you ship
* Contribute to code reviews and technical planning, and keep the systems you own stable and observable
* Help shape how the Investments team works as it grows

 **What we're looking for**

* 6\+ years building backend systems in production (.NET 10, PostgreSQL, Azure/AWS), comfortable picking up frontend (React/TypeScript) when needed
* Experience designing and maintaining integrations with third\-party APIs
* Strong understanding of data modelling, event\-driven patterns, and building for correctness and auditability
* A clear communicator who can talk to engineers and customers, and knows which version to use with which audience
* A product mindset and a bias to bring ideas, not just execute them, proactively adding to the roadmap
* You take real ownership, if a request from a client or lead doesn't match your own understanding of the problem, you say so rather than building to spec anyway
* You think carefully about reliability, security and compliance, and are comfortable with ambiguity and ownership in a fast\-growing startup
* AI\-forward mindset, we use AI daily to build and improve our systems and expect you to as well

 **Why join us?**

* **Technically interesting problem** \- pension infrastructure is genuinely complex: multi\-provider, multi\-market and largely unmodernised
* **Modern stack** \- .NET 10, PostgreSQL, React, TypeScript, Next.js, Azure/AWS, event\-driven
* **Agency** \- we hire people and trust them. You'll own meaningful parts of the system end to end
* **Customer proximity** \- you'll see the impact of what you build, and hear directly from the people using it

new_jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (Data Ingestion Platform)
new_jobs.description:
**Who we are**


4C Strategies builds organisational readiness and military training management software for clients in over 70 countries. Our flagship product, Exonaut, is used by NATO and allied forces to plan, run and evaluate exercises in real time. Our consultants and engineers work alongside armed forces across the UK, Europe, North America and beyond to deliver training and exercise management solutions.

**What we're building**


We're building the data ingestion platform behind large\-scale training exercises: a service that takes traffic from simulation federations, unmanned\-system sensor networks and real\-world sensor feeds, and turns it into one coherent stream that subscribing systems can act on. The bet is that these streams should be interpreted and mapped to an internal Ontology rather than re\-interpreted by every product that needs it. So the hard part is as much modelling as engineering — deciding what those bytes actually mean, and then holding that meaning stable as the number of sources and consumers grows. The platform is greenfield, and you'll have real influence over its shape.

**How we build**


Modern Java. The principles are conservative on purpose: boring technology, simplicity over cleverness, in\-process over distributed, shared\-nothing over shared state, domain wrapped by ports and adapters. Redundancy is an architectural property, not an operational afterthought. Designs are argued from the problem, not from what a framework happens to make easy. Proposals go through RFCs; decisions are recorded in ADRs.


Two constraints shape most of what we do. Everything the platform produces must be traceable back to the raw feed and the exact configuration that produced it — a customer has to be able to replay an exercise and defend the result. And it has to run where exercises actually run: constrained hardware, intermittent connectivity, air\-gapped sites, limited patch windows, secure by design and observability good enough for an operator in the field with no one to call.

**You**


Substantial engineering experience, opinionated about design, and comfortable arguing a position in writing. Sound judgement on reliability, security, performance, operations and cost is mandatory. Familiarity with simulation or sensor standards, IoT, geospatial mathematics or high\-throughput ingestion is a real advantage — the domain is learnable, the principles less so. We'd also rather hear about how you simplified a distributed system rather than the one you built using multiple services.


The engineering team is small, but what we are building sits at the centre of the portfolio and draws the people who know this domain best — some of the strongest simulation and modelling expertise anywhere in the field is in this building, and closely engaged in what we're building. The bar is high. Your designs will be challenged, and you'll be expected to challenge back — including on scope, since most of the pressure on a platform like this comes as reasonable\-sounding requests for one more special case.


Research shows some people only apply when they meet every requirement. If you don't tick every box but recognise yourself in much of the above, please apply anyway. We'd genuinely like to hear from you.

**Security and citizenship**


This role supports defence work, so the successful candidate must hold Swedish citizenship and pass Swedish security vetting (säkerhetsprövning). We will explain what the check involves early in the process rather than late — a requirement like this should never be a surprise at offer stage.


This requirement comes only from the security rules that govern defence work, not from personal preference.

**Why it matters**


Deterrence works only when a capability is real, and a capability is only real once it has been trained and tested under conditions close to the ones it would face. This is about making sure the organisations that would hold the line are ready.

**How we hire**


Every interview has a written script and a scored rubric, applied the same way to every candidate.

* **Hiring Manager Screen** — a conversation about your experience, how you work and what


you want next.

* **System Design** — a design discussion drawn from problems like the ones above.
* **Programming** — a hands\-on session in a language of your choice (Java, C\#, TypeScript, Python or Go).
* **Culture Interview** — how you collaborate, disagree and make decisions with others.
* **Candidate Q\&A** — your time to interrogate us. We expect you to use it.


We then debrief as a panel and decide. We review applications on a rolling basis.

**What you can expect from 4C Strategies**

* Stockholm\-based, with hybrid working.
* Competitive salary, reviewed annually.
* Occupational pension (tjänstepension).
* Wellness allowance (friskvårdsbidrag).
* Healthcare insurance, including insurance for treatment.
* Parental pay.
* Vaccinations.
* A supportive, collaborative team building meaningful products for mission\-critical work.

**Why Join 4C Strategies**


If you're happiest when the path isn't drawn yet, this is a rare chance to own hard, open problems on a large, multi\-year programme — real scale, real production systems, and the freedom to shape how they're built — with a collaborative team to figure the hard parts out alongside you. You'll work alongside experienced engineers and military specialists, with the individual\-contributor track valued as highly as management, so you can grow without leaving the code behind.


The work matters: what you build helps armed forces, public safety and resilience organisations train, prepare, and respond. If you want senior\-level ownership on systems that are used in earnest — not a backlog ticket factory — this is that role.

**How to apply**


To apply, click the Apply today button and submit your CV. A short cover note on your experience and motivation is welcome but not required. We review applications on a rolling basis, so please apply as soon as you can.


4C Strategies is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

new_jobs.title: People and Project Manager - for AI-assisted diagnostic medical software
new_jobs.description:
In 3Shape we work to improve treatment and diagnostics for dental patients by providing innovative scanners and advanced software, tied together in collaborative workflows for the global community of dental professionals worldwide. We are using AI and machine learning methods for analyzing large amounts of medical (dentistry) data – pushing a field which traditionally has looked at 2D images towards 3D scan data.

**The product**


TRIOS Dx offers AI\-assisted dental diagnostic aid tools for monitoring oral health conditions and assessing changes in teeth and gingiva. By analyzing a 3D scan TRIOS Dx assists in diagnosing Caries, Tooth Wear, Gingival recession, and Plaque.


TRIOS Dx was made public and available to end users last year. We are now in a phase where we listen to market feedback and improve the product. We also plan to add new and existing functionality to it over the next many years.

**The position**


We are looking for a skilled People \& Project Manager for the AI team currently responsible for the AI’s diagnosing Caries, Tooth Wear, Gingival recession, and Plaque. You will be driving end\-to\-end delivery of innovative AI solutions and will during this play a key role in ensuring we use state\-of\-the\-art AI solutions, have the right data for AI development, and have thorough and efficient documentation required to get AP approved for use in a Medical Device software. Your main tasks include:

* Build, coach, and develop the team, cultivating an environment where people can do the best work of their lives.
* Lead your team through the full product lifecycle \- from ideation and development to deployment, monitoring, and iteration based on customer feedback.
* Ensure the team have clear ownership of domains, responsibilities, and deliverables.


You will be collaborating with various professionals such as application developers, AI developers, QA, RA, Product Management, and a Clinical Research team of dental professionals.

**Your profile**


We are looking for candidates with a good understanding of the AI and AI development. You may have experience from related positions, and you have a relevant education.

* Master’s degree or a PhD in Data Science, Computer Science, Bioinformatics, Engineering or a related field
* 2\+ years of leadership experience managing and growing engineering teams.
* Proven experience with Machine Learning (e.g. deep neural networks, supervised and unsupervised learning), preferably within image processing or processing of 3D data
* Solid software development skills, preferably in Python and C\#
* Mindset for quality, flexibility, creativity, emerging technologies


In our search for a new colleague, we always look for people with a cross\-disciplinary and open mindset. Through cooperation with program managers, project managers, developers, testers, and Regulatory Affair specialists; you will get an in\-depth understanding of all aspects of medical software development and use this to enable further growth and success.

**Get in touch now!**


Please do not hesitate to apply as soon for this exciting opportunity at one of Denmark’s most successful and fastest\-growing high\-tech companies, as applications will be processed continuously. The deadline for application is **10\. October**. We look forward to hearing from you.


We encourage all relevant applicants to apply. We are committed to celebrating human diversity, and we trust that the best way to reach outstanding business results, is by welcoming diverse people into our community.

**About us**


3Shape started with a simple idea \- to make 3D scanning better. First, we applied it to the hearing industry, then we succeeded in dentistry. Twenty years later, 3Shape has 2,000\+ employees globally. With the help of dental professionals and amazing colleagues we’re creating award\-winning scanning and CAD/CAM solutions to change dentistry together! Together, we contribute to a better world. Experience the everyday \#lifeat3Shape across the globe on LinkedIn.

* Drive a strong safety culture across all engineering activities, integrating "Safety in Design" and "Safety in Construction" principles.

* Ensure full compliance with Group HSE standards, security policies, and technical regulations across all assigned projects.

**Project Conceptualization \& Feasibility**  

* Develop robust, safe, and cost\-effective electrical and automation engineering concepts for business cases, feasibility studies, and tender packages.

* Analyse plant KPIs to assist CAPEX Project Managers in establishing accurate CAPEX/OPEX estimates and production targets.

* Evaluate tender submissions to identify technically sound, commercially optimal solutions.

**Detailed Engineering \& Quality Control**  

* Review detailed design documentation to ensure compliance with Group standards, safety requirements, maintainability, durability, and cost efficiency.

* Oversee quality control, technical inspections, and execution of electrical and automation packages during project implementation.

* Provide targeted, high\-value technical support during the commissioning and performance\-testing phases.

**Supplier Management \& Technical Governance**  

* Qualify global suppliers for electrical systems, power distribution, and drive technologies, maintaining a strong understanding of market capabilities.

* Develop and continuously refine standard design criteria, engineering tools (e.g., eDM, IBS), and technical best practices across the organization.

* Represent the discipline in knowledge\-sharing platforms and cross\-functional technical roundtables.

**Project \& Stakeholder Management**  

* Simultaneously manage electrical and automation deliverables across multiple concurrent projects based on priority.

* Collaborate effectively within diverse, multicultural, and multidisciplinary engineering teams across international locations.

**Your Profile**

  

* **Education:** University degree in Electrical Engineering, Automation Engineering, or a closely related discipline.

* **Experience:** Minimum 5 years of hands\-on experience in industrial CAPEX project engineering (Cement, Heavy Industry, or Process Engineering preferred).

### **Technical \& Functional Skills**

  

* Deep knowledge of international electrical and automation engineering standards, tools, and methodologies.

* Proven experience in large\-scale CAPEX project execution, tender preparation, and vendor selection.

* Familiarity with heavy process industries (e.g., Cement, Energy, Carbon Capture).

  

  

### **Leadership \& Behavioural Competencies**

  

* **Technical Leadership:** Ability to influence stakeholders and establish credibility through technical expertise rather than direct authority.

* **Adaptability \& Resilience:** Comfortable working autonomously, managing shifting priorities, and conducting site assessments in remote or challenging environments.

* **Communication \& Negotiation:** Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to bridge complex technical details with commercial and operational teams across global sites.

* **Mindset:** Highly analytical, rigorous, cost\-conscious, and open to continuous improvement and technical innovation.

### **Languages \& Mobility**

  

* **Languages:** Professional working proficiency in English (written and spoken) is required. Proficiency in additional core Group languages is a plus.

* **Mobility:** Willingness to travel frequently to project locations, supplier facilities, and construction sites worldwide, including regions with basic infrastructure or remote conditions.

new_jobs.title: AI Software Engineer (m/w/d)
new_jobs.description:
Wir sind mutig und innovativ, neugierig und kreativ, bodenständig und ganz klar auf den Erfolg unserer Kunden fokussiert. Unsere Ideen und unser Know\-how fließen in einzigartige Maschinen\- und Anlagenlösungen für **internationale Unternehmen** aus der **holz\-, metall\- und kunststoffbearbeitenden Industrie**. **International bekannte Möbelmarken** setzen ebenso auf unsere Erfahrung wie der **weltgrößte Flugzeughersteller** oder der **anspruchsvolle Tischlerbetrieb von nebenan**. Manche Anlage erreicht die **Größe von bis zu zwei Fußballfeldern** – das geht, weil wir über **100 Jahre Pionierarbeit auf höchstem Niveau** mit im Gepäck haben. Ambitionierte Nachwuchs\-, Fach\- und Führungskräfte finden bei uns das perfekte Umfeld für ihre Talente. **Bist Du mit dabei?**

**Wir bieten**

* Spannende Aufgaben in einem international tätigen Hightech\-Unternehmen
* Die Chance, KI bei uns von der Idee bis in den produktiven Einsatz zu bringen – in unseren Produkten, im Service und in der täglichen Arbeit
* Ein internationales Umfeld mit Kolleginnen und Kollegen an Standorten in Europa, Asien und Amerika
* Ein Themenfeld, das Du inhaltlich prägst, statt es zu verwalten
* Kurzen Weg zur KI\-Strategie der Unternehmensgruppe und schnelle Entscheidungen
* Flexible Arbeitszeiten
* Kollegiales Umfeld mit flachen Hierarchien
* Individuelle Weiterbildungs\- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten – Lernzeit ist bei uns Arbeitszeit
* Attraktive Benefits (Gesundheitsförderung, Digibon, Mitarbeiterrabatte, Bikeleasing, Firmenevents,..)

**Deine Aufgaben**

* Du verfolgst, was sich bei KI\-Technologien tut, prüfst neue Ansätze auf ihren Nutzen und setzt das Passende bei uns ein – von großen Sprachmodellen über Agenten bis zu Retrieval\-Verfahren
* Du entwirfst und baust KI\-gestützte Werkzeuge und begleitest sie vom ersten Versuch bis zu einer Lösung, die im Alltag zuverlässig läuft
* Du machst unsere internen Abläufe mit KI spürbar schneller und einfacher – in Entwicklung, Service, Vertrieb und Verwaltung
* Du bringst KI dorthin, wo bei uns gearbeitet wird – in unsere Softwareprodukte und in die Systeme der Unternehmensgruppe
* Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Entwicklerinnen und Entwicklern sowie den Fachbereichen zusammen und übersetzt zwischen Anforderung und Technik
* Du behältst unsere KI\-Werkzeuge im Betrieb im Blick, schärfst sie nach und entwickelst sie weiter – damit sie nach dem Start nicht liegen bleiben
* Du gibst Dein Wissen weiter und begleitest unsere Teams beim Einsatz von KI\-Werkzeugen

 **Dein Profil**

* Abgeschlossene Ausbildung im Bereich Informatik oder Softwareentwicklung (HTL, FH, Universität oder vergleichbare Qualifikation)
* Du hast bereits selbst mit Sprachmodellen, Agenten, RAG, MCP und Prompt Engineering gearbeitet
* Du schreibst Code, den auch andere noch warten können – idealerweise in Python oder C\#
* Du weißt, wie Agenten aufgebaut sind und wie sich Abläufe zwischen ihnen sinnvoll steuern lassen
* Echte Begeisterung für das Thema – und Freude daran, laufend Neues dazuzulernen
* Freude daran, mit Fachbereichen zu sprechen und aus einem Problem einen greifbaren Anwendungsfall zu machen
* Grundverständnis für Cloud\-Themen (Microsoft Azure) – Erfahrung im DevOps\-Umfeld ist ein Plus, aber kein Muss
* Gute Deutsch\- und Englischkenntnisse

new_jobs.description:
We are knowmad mood!


Somos una compañía líder en transformación digital, en constante evolución y a la vanguardia de la tecnología. Nacimos para provocar un cambio real a través de la innovación y el desarrollo sostenible, con la misión de aportar valor a los clientes e impulsar nuestro talento.


Formado por más de 3\.000 personas creativas, digitales e innovadoras conectadas a un propósito y capaces de generar conexiones con personas de todo el mundo. Un equipo responsable, flexible y con alta capacidad de adaptación a las necesidades de nuestros clientes y del mercado, a la vez que proporciona valor, visión, creatividad, expertise, profesionalidad y pasión por la tecnología en cada proyecto.


Los valores que marcan nuestro rumbo y nos guían hacia la excelencia son la colaboración, la innovación, el compromiso, la diversión y la conﬁanza.

 **¿Qué es lo que valoramos?**


Experiencia de al menos 5 años como Desarrollador Senior .NET o Consultor Técnico en entornos empresariales complejos:

* Experiencia sólida en desarrollo y mantenimiento de aplicaciones .NET y .NET Framework.
* Conocimientos avanzados en arquitectura de aplicaciones, refactorización de código, modernización tecnológica y gestión del ciclo de vida del software.
* Experiencia trabajando con observabilidad, monitorización y análisis de rendimiento mediante herramientas como Kibana, Grafana, Elastic Stack o similares.
* Conocimientos en actualización y migración de frameworks, dependencias y componentes tecnológicos en entornos productivos.
* Experiencia en la gestión y mitigación de vulnerabilidades de seguridad, tanto a nivel de código como de arquitectura e infraestructura.
* Capacidad para analizar dependencias técnicas complejas entre aplicaciones, servicios, sistemas operativos y componentes corporativos.
* Experiencia en documentación técnica, inventariado de aplicaciones y definición de relaciones entre sistemas.
* Capacidad de trabajo en equipo y comunicación efectiva con equipos técnicos, arquitectura, ciberseguridad y negocio..

**¿Cuáles serían tus funciones?**

* **Modernización y Evolución Aplicativa:** Refactorizar, optimizar, actualizar y sanear las aplicaciones actualmente en producción, garantizando su mantenibilidad, rendimiento y alineamiento con los estándares tecnológicos corporativos.
* **Observabilidad y Monitorización:** Diseñar e implementar métricas, trazabilidad y dashboards que permitan mejorar la observabilidad de las aplicaciones mediante herramientas como Kibana, Grafana y otras soluciones del ecosistema.
* **Gestión de Vulnerabilidades:** Analizar y mitigar vulnerabilidades identificadas por los equipos de ciberseguridad, impulsando tanto mejoras de código como actualizaciones de componentes, frameworks y plataformas.
* **Arquitectura e IT4IT:** Participar en iniciativas de arquitectura técnica y gobierno IT4IT, evaluando dependencias, definiendo soluciones de mejora continua y asegurando la sostenibilidad tecnológica de los sistemas.
* **Actualización Tecnológica:** Liderar procesos de actualización de frameworks, librerías, componentes y sistemas operativos cuando las aplicaciones presenten dependencias que lo requieran.
* **Documentación Técnica:** Mantener actualizado el inventario de aplicaciones y componentes, documentando la arquitectura desplegada y las relaciones existentes entre los diferentes sistemas.
* **Colaboración Multidisciplinaria:** Trabajar estrechamente con equipos de desarrollo, operaciones, arquitectura y ciberseguridad para garantizar la evolución continua de los entornos tecnológicos.

 **Además, valoraremos muy positivamente si tienes experiencia y/o conocimientos en:**

* Arquitecturas distribuidas, microservicios y patrones de integración.
* Elastic Stack (ELK), Grafana, Prometheus o herramientas equivalentes de observabilidad.
* Azure Cloud y arquitecturas basadas en la nube.
* DevOps, CI/CD y automatización de despliegues.
* SonarQube, análisis de calidad de código y gestión de deuda técnica.
* OWASP, Secure Coding y buenas prácticas de ciberseguridad.
* Kubernetes, Docker y plataformas de contenedorización.
* Metodologías ágiles de desarrollo (Scrum, Kanban).

new_jobs.description:
Capgemini Engineering, líder mundial en servicios de ingeniería, reúne equipos de ingenieros/as, científicos/as y arquitectos/as para ayudar a las empresas más innovadoras del mundo a liberar su potencial y contribuir a un futuro mejor. Desde coches autónomos hasta robots que salvan vidas, nuestros/as expertos/as en tecnologías digitales y software se salen de lo convencional proporcionando servicios únicos de I\+D e ingeniería en todos los sectores de actividad. ¡Únete al equipo y continúa tu carrera en una compañía con oportunidades de crecimiento, donde puedes marcar la diferencia y donde ningún día es igual al anterior!

  

En Capgemini Engineering estamos buscando un perfil de **Arquitecto/a SW de Sistemas Distribuidos** para **diseño, desarrollo y despliegue de proyectos basados en arquitecturas distribuidas desacopladas con experiencia en .NET** .

  

**¿Cuál será tu rol?**

* Diseño, desarrollo y despliegue de proyectos de sistemas distribuidos desacoplados.
* Experiencia en migración de aplicaciones hacia arquitecturas basadas en servicios.
* Buena capacidad comunicativa, tanto oral como escrita.
* Experiencia en metodologías ágiles.
* Capacidad para trabajar en equipos internacionales.
* Iniciativa propia y autonomía en la resolución de problemas.
* 3 días oficina \+ 2 teletrabajo
* Inglés avanzado
  

**Tu perfil**

* **5 años** en proyectos de arquitectura y desarrollo de microservicios.
* Diseño de microservicios, Event\-Driven Architecture.
* CQRS, Clean Architecture, DDD, Observabilidad y resiliencia.
* Arquitecturas cloud: AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud, Privada OpenStack e híbridas
* Arquitecturas de seguridad End\-to\-End: Zero Trust, Gestión de identidad...
* APIs y comunicaciones: REST, GraphQL, gRPC
* Buenas prácticas de desarrollo: Clean Code, SOLID, TDD

new_jobs.title: Senior Enterprise Network Technology Engineer
new_jobs.description:
**Entity:**

Technology  

  

**Job Family Group:**

IT\&S Group  

  

**Job Description:**

  

Our purpose is to deliver energy to the world, today and tomorrow. For over 100 years, bp has focused on discovering, developing, and producing oil and gas in the nations where we operate. We are one of the few companies globally that can provide governments and customers with an integrated energy offering. Delivering our strategy sustainably is fundamental to achieving our ambition to be a net zero company by 2050 or sooner.

  

It's an exciting time to join bp. Meeting the energy challenge requires many different approaches and solutions. And as part of Finance Business \& Technology (FBT), you’ll be fully connected into the world of bp. You’ll play an increasingly important part within a network of like\-minded colleagues partnering on strategic projects that stretch across the globe. And it starts with you. There’s a world of opportunities to build new skills, challenge yourself and grow a long\-term career at bp. And no matter where you work, your role will have meaning, purpose and impact. So if you want to be part of a caring, supportive environment where you can realize your full potential, we’re with you.

  

*Join our Technology Team and advance your career as a* ***Senior Enterprise Network Technology Engineer***

  

The **Senior Enterprise Network Technology Engineer** is a senior technical role within Enterprise Network


Services (ENS), responsible for designing, implementing and continuously improving bp's enterprise network services.


The role provides deep technical expertise across enterprise LAN, Wireless LAN (WLAN), SD\-WAN and network infrastructure technologies, supporting network transformation, site refresh, migration and operational improvement initiatives. The incumbent acts as a senior partner concern point for complex technical issues, provides technical guidance to operations teams and suppliers, and contributes to the development of secure, reliable and scalable network solutions that support bp's global business operations.

  

***In this role You will:***


* Design, implement and support enterprise LAN, WLAN and SD\-WAN solutions across bp's global network estate.
* Lead technical delivery of network engineering, migration, site refresh and modernization initiatives.
* Act as a senior technical issue point for complex network incidents, major problems and engineering challenges.
* Provide technical leadership and guidance to Level 2 support teams, engineering peers and managed service providers.
* Engineer and support Aruba switching, Aruba wireless, Aruba Central and associated network management platforms.
* Produce and maintain network designs, implementation plans, technical standards and operational documentation.
* Solve complex routing, switching, wireless, authentication and connectivity issues.
* Drive root cause analysis and implementation of permanent corrective actions.
* Collaborate with architecture, security, operations, project delivery teams and vendors to ensure successful solution delivery.
* Find opportunities for automation, standardization and continuous improvement across the network environment.
* Ensure compliance with bp technology, cyber security and operational standards.
  

***What You will need to be successful:***


* Degree in computer science, Information Technology, Telecommunications, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent relevant industry experience
* Relevant industry certifications are beneficial
* Solid experience in enterprise network engineering within large and complex environments
* Advanced knowledge of Cisco networking technologies
* Experience with enterprise routing, switching and network fix
* Strong hands\-on practical skills in LAN and wireless networking technologies
* Proficiency with Aruba switching, Aruba Wireless and Aruba Central platforms
* Experience with SD\-WAN technologies and enterprise connectivity solutions
* Familiarity in diagnosing and resolving complex technical issues beyond standard operational support
* Experience designing, implementing and supporting network infrastructure projects and migrations
* Experience producing and reviewing network designs and user documentation
* Understanding of network authentication and access control technologies
* Experience working with globally distributed teams, suppliers and service providers
* Strong analytical, solve and problem\-solving skills
* Excellent English verbal and written communication skills
* Ability to work independently, take technical ownership and deliver outcomes in a fast\-paced environment
  

***Desirable criteria:***


* Experience with Versa SD\-WAN solutions
* Knowledge with Juniper and Fortinet technologies, Aruba ClearPass
* Ability to reviewing wireless survey outputs and WLAN optimization activities
* Knowledge of cloud networking concepts within Azure and/or AWS environments
* Familiarity with network automation using Python, Ansible or REST APIs
* Exposure working in industrial or operationally critical environments
* ITIL Foundation certification or equivalent knowledge
* Cisco, Aruba, Juniper, Versa or Fortinet certifications
  

***At bp, we provide the following environment \& benefits to you:***


* Different bonus opportunities based on performance, wide range of cafeteria elements
* Life \& health insurance, medical care package
* Hybrid working arrangement aligned with team arrangements and business needs
* Opportunity to build up long\-term career path and develop your skills with wide range of learning options
* Celebrate in bp’s success. You may be eligible to join bp’s Global ShareMatch plan. This non\-contractual benefit lets employees buy bp shares and receive matching shares, in line with plan rules
* Family friendly workplace e.g.: Extended parental leave, Mother\-baby room
* Employees’ wellbeing programs e.g.: Employee Assistance Program, Company Recognition Program
* Possibility to join our social communities and networks
* Chill\-out and collaboration spaces in our beautiful Budapest Agora and Szeged offices e.g.: Play Zones, Office massage, Sport and music equipment
  

**bp Hungary won the Most Attractive Employer 2024 Award (SSC / BSC sector) fourth time in a row at PwC's annual employer research. Come and join us!**

  

At bp, we support our people to learn and grow in a diverse and ambitious environment. We believe that our team is strengthened by diversity. We are committed to fostering an inclusive environment in which everyone is respected and treated fairly. There are many aspects of our employees’ lives that are meaningful, so we offer benefits to enable your work to fit with your life.

  

Disclaimer: Please note that, according to Hungarian law (2012/I. 113\. §), mothers or single parents caring for a child under three years of age cannot be employed in night shift positions.

  

  

**Travel Requirement**


Negligible travel should be expected with this role  

  

**Relocation Assistance:**


This role is eligible for relocation within country  

  

**Remote Type:**


This position is a hybrid of office/remote working  

  

**Skills:**


Commercial Acumen, Communication, Data Analysis, Data cleansing and transformation, Data domain knowledge, Data Integration, Data Management, Data Manipulation, Data Sourcing, Data strategy and governance, Data Structures and Algorithms (Inactive), Data visualization and interpretation, Digital Security, Extract, transform and load, Group Problem Solving
.
